title: Multidisciplinary Creative
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, versatile Multidisciplinary Creative who can move fluidly across video, design, UI/UX, and AI, and make it all look effortless.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an \"unlimited get-shit-done\" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You'll Do


  • Edit and produce video content across formats, social, brand, campaign, and everything in between.
  • Design compelling visual assets across digital and print, maintaining brand consistency and creative quality.
  • Lead and execute UI/UX work, from wireframes and user flows to polished, production-ready interfaces.
  • Leverage AI tools to enhance and accelerate creative output, from ideation to execution.
  • Collaborate with strategists, account managers, and developers to bring creative concepts to life across multiple channels.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously without dropping the ball on quality or deadlines.
  • Stay ahead of design trends, tools, and AI-powered workflows that keep our creative output cutting edge.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of hands-on experience across graphic design, video editing, and UI/UX, not just one of them.
  • A strong portfolio that proves you can move across disciplines without losing quality.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop), Figma, and Canva.
  • Real experience using AI tools in a creative workflow (image generation, video AI, copy assistance, etc.).
  • A solid eye for typography, layout, motion, and user experience.
  • Ability to take creative direction and run with it independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills, you know how to present your work and take feedback like a pro.


Bonus Points


  • Experience with Webflow or basic front-end knowledge (HTML/CSS).
  • Motion graphics or animation experience beyond basic video editing.
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.
  • Familiarity with AI design tools like Midjourney, ElevenLabs, or equivalents.


Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you're someone who thrives on variety, gets excited by creative challenges across multiple disciplines, and loves using the latest tools to push work further, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior
description:
Sobre a Volpi

Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário . Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais . Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!


O desafio

Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.

Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.

Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
  • Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
  • Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance ;
  • Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
  • Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
  • Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
  • Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
  • Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.


O que esperamos de você:

title: Product Owner
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.


Intro video:


Responsibilities

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members.

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Collaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

  • Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output:

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.


Qualifications

  • Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively.
  • Excellent Communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Software Development processes and tools to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Prior experience in a similar role is preferred.
  • Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not required


Notes

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Hiring interviews are online.

title: Data Entry & Research Coordinator (English Required)
description:
Overview

Full Spectrum Search Group is a national healthcare recruiting firm focused on post-acute and senior care leadership, including skilled nursing, senior living, home health, and hospice.


We are hiring a Data Entry & Research Coordinator to support our recruiting team by maintaining and updating candidate information in our internal database.


This role is ideal for detail-oriented, organized professionals early in their careers who are comfortable working with large amounts of information and ensuring data is accurate, complete, and up to date.


The Role

This is a production-focused position responsible for entering, updating, and correcting candidate data. Your work ensures our recruiting team has clean, reliable information to operate efficiently. This is not a technical or IT role. The focus is on accuracy, organization, and consistency.


What You Will Do


Data Entry and Updates

  • Enter and update candidate information in internal systems
  • Review records for missing, incorrect, or outdated information
  • Make corrections to ensure data is accurate and complete
  • Research and Data Collection
  • Use LinkedIn, Google, and other tools to find and verify candidate information
  • Add relevant details such as contact information, job titles, and company data

Data Quality and Organization

  • Maintain clean and well-structured records
  • Ensure all data is ready for recruiter use with minimal revisions
  • Track progress and stay organized across multiple assignments

Team Support

  • Work closely with recruiters to support ongoing searches
  • Follow instructions and adjust priorities as needed
  • Communicate clearly regarding progress or questions


Requirements


  • Advanced English (required) – written and reading comprehension
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • High level of organization and ability to follow processes
  • Ability to handle repetitive tasks with consistency and focus
  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Excel)
  • Ability to manage time and meet deadlines


Preferred Background


  • Experience in data entry, administrative support, research, or similar roles
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn or online research tools is a plus
  • College degree preferred but not required


What We Look For


  • You are detail-oriented and catch mistakes easily
  • You are reliable and follow through on tasks
  • You are comfortable doing repetitive, process-driven work
  • You take pride in keeping information clean and organized


Compensation and Logistics


  • Competitive compensation based on experience
  • Full-time remote position
  • US Central Time schedule
  • Growth opportunities based on performance


This is a great opportunity for someone looking to build experience in a structured, professional environment while developing strong organizational and data management skills.

title: ANALISTA CONTÁBIL PL
description:
SOBRE A MAPFRE

Você já pensou em trabalhar em uma das maiores seguradoras do mundo? Além de ter o maior e mais completo portfólio do mercado, trabalhamos para proteger milhões de sonhos, vidas, bens e temos como missão cuidar do que é importante para você e nossos clientes, garantindo segurança, tranquilidade e proteção.

Completamos 90 anos no mercado, operando em mais de 100 países nos 05 continentes e contamos com um time de mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todo o mundo. Presente desde 1992 no Brasil, atuamos com Investimentos, Consórcios, Capitalização, Previdência e Vida Resgatável, Saúde, Seguros e Assistência.


Nosso compromisso com a sociedade

Aqui na MAPFRE contribuímos para uma sociedade mais sustentável, solidária e inclusiva. Temos o compromisso em apoiar diversidade, construindo um ambiente com igualdade e equidade. Valorizamos e apoiamos a presença de mulheres em cargo de gestão, a contratação de pessoa com deficiência e o equilíbrio racial e de gênero em nossas equipes.


Essa é a nossa pegada! Gostou? Confira os detalhes da vaga abaixo:


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Será responsável por rotinas de fechamento contábil, elaboração de conciliações contábeis, apoio na elaboração de notas explicativas, análise e justificativas das variações de saldos do Balanço e atendimento a auditorias interna e externa. Dentre as principais atividades, estão:

  • Conciliações contábeis;
  • Revisão de processos contábeis e automações de atividades;
  • Elaboração de notas explicativas;
  • Atendimento a auditorias e órgãos fiscalizadores;
  • Apoiar na homologação contábil de produtos e sistemas;
  • Acompanhar e justificar variações de Balanço;
  • Apoiar todo o fluxo de fechamento contábil mensal.


REQUISITOS

Formação acadêmica completa em Ciências Contábeis;

Necessário CRC Ativo;

Conhecimento e vivência comprovada nas principais rotinas de fechamento contábil;

Conciliações contábeis;

Notas explicativas;

Análise e interpretação das variações de balanço;

Desejável conhecimento no sistema ERP SAP;

Experiência no mercado de seguros com conhecimento sobre as principais operações do segmento;

Excel intermediário/avançado;

Disponibilidade de horário para os períodos de fechamento contábil;

Residir em São Paulo/SP;


Local de trabalho: Berrini (Zona Sul de São Paulo)

Formato de trabalho: Híbrido – 3 dias presenciais no escritório


NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS

A MAPFRE é feita de pessoas, por isso retribuímos da melhor maneira possível o comprometimento de nossos colaboradores, que contam com:

  • A jornada diária conta com horário flexível, formato de trabalho híbrido;
  • Incentivo a saúde e qualidade de vida com Seguro de Vida e Plano Médico e Odontológico extensivo a dependentes, pois proteger as pessoas não é só um discurso;
  • Incentivo à Previdência Privada, pensando na tranquilidade do seu futuro;
  • Programa de participação nos Lucros e Resultados (Anual);
  • Wellhub;
  • Clube de Benefícios MAPFRE, que proporciona muitos descontos;
  • Condições especiais na contratação de seguros da MAPFRE;
  • Extensão da licença e maternidade para 180 dias e paternidade para 20 dias, além do retorno gradativo da licença maternidade e paternidade. E os papais e mamães com filhos de até 6 anos também recebem o Auxílio Creche ou Auxílio Babá.
  • Disponibilização de cursos e treinamentos presenciais e E-learning em nossa plataforma digital, a Universidade Corporativa MAPFRE.
  • A Assessoria do Programa Viva Leve está sempre aberta para ouvir via atendimento 0800 com psicólogos, assistentes sociais, orientações de nutricionistas, fisioterapeutas, além de consultoria Pet e orientações com profissionais da área jurídica.


Nos importamos com o desenvolvimento dos nossos colaboradores e para isso, trabalhamos programas que promovem mobilidade, desenvolvimento, oportunidades de carreira e crescimento profissional. Mais do que apoiar, celebramos cada conquista!

Confira nossas ações para promover desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional e pessoal:

  • Programas de treinamento e desenvolvimento;
  • Mobilidade funcional e geográfica;
  • Avaliação de desempenho 360º;
  • Benefícios sociais e programas de saúde;
  • Projetos de voluntariado corporativo;

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis

  • Garantir o planejamento e execução dos programas de desenvolvimento técnico, comportamental e de liderança.

  • Coordenar o desdobramento e a execução dos projetos estratégicos de sucessão, cultura organizacional, employer branding e engajamento, assegurando a adaptação às necessidades locais e o alinhamento com as diretrizes corporativas.
  • Coordenar o processo de avaliação de desempenho, garantindo sua aplicação conforme os ciclos definidos, apoiando as lideranças na análise dos resultados e no planejamento de ações de desenvolvimento individual e organizacional.
  • Elaborar e acompanhar o orçamento da área, controlando investimentos em treinamento e seleção.
  • Acompanhar e analisar os indicadores de desempenho da área de DHO, propondo planos de ação para melhoria contínua.
  • Garantir a execução e padronização dos processos conforme as diretrizes corporativas de RH.
  • Atuar como parceiro das lideranças na construção e execução de soluções de desenvolvimento humano.
  • Representar a área de DHO em auditorias, reuniões corporativas e projetos transversais da companhia.
  • Realizar outras atividades correlatas às descritas acima, compatível com a sua condição pessoal e conforme solicitado pelo seu superior imediato.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Psicologia, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável pós-graduação em Gestão de Pessoas ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência com gestão de pessoas.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana-BA.
  • Domínio em gestão de processos de R&S, T&D, clima e cultura, em planejamento e execução de programas de desenvolvimento e sucessão.

title: Virtual Assistant (Remote)
description:
Job Overview:

We are looking for a highly organized Virtual Assistant for a remote role supporting a residential cleaning company based in California, USA. We are a small cleaning service business, so this role works closely with me as the owner and is involved in several parts of the daily operation, including client communication and administrative coordination. 


Type of Contract: Independent Contractor, Brazilian MEI - micro-entrepreneur.


Working Hours: This is a long term position with two schedule options, 30 or 36 hours per week . The role requires a start time around 7:30 am Pacific Time (California), which is 11:30 am in Brazil. 

There is some flexibility in the exact schedule, which can be discussed based on the candidate’s availability and mutual fit.


Compensation: R$ 3,000 for 30 hours per week, or R$ 3,600 for 36 hours per week, plus performance bonus.


Requirements:


  • Fluency in English
  • Basic to Intermediate Spanish
  • Comfortable speaking with clients by phone in English, including handling initial inquiries, asking screening questions, and sharing basic service information
  • Strong written communication skills in English, including clear and professional emails and client messages
  • Strong knowledge of Google Workspace, including Docs, Sheets, Drive, and related tools
  • Confident using Google tools and navigating online efficiently, including search commands
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection 
  • High-quality headset with noise cancellation and voice isolation
  • Quiet, interruption-free workspace during all working hours (you’ll handle live client calls)


Responsibilities :


  • Answer incoming client calls in English
  • Provide customer support, including client email communication
  • Update and maintain client information in the CRM and other digital records
  • Support administrative tasks, including scheduling, calendar coordination, and day to day follow through
  • Communicate with the cleaning staff in Spanish for day to day coordination, mainly through WhatsApp, with occasional phone communication when needed


If this sounds like the right fit for you, please send your resume , along with a 1 to 2 minute video in English sharing a bit about your professional experience to


Thank you!

About Hydroh:

Our product line includes hydrogen water bottles, supplements, and accessories all designed to help people recover faster, reduce inflammation, and feel their best.


We’re looking for a Performance Video Editor who deeply understands how to cut direct response ads for Meta (Facebook/Instagram), TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. This is NOT a branding video role we’re talking scroll-stopping hooks, retention-driven pacing, and revenue-first editing.

  • Full-Time, 40 hours per week (Flexible Schedule just a few hours overlap with EST is fine)

  • 2+ years experience editing direct response video ads for DTC brands
  • Portfolio of paid ads you've edited (Meta, TikTok, YT Shorts — performance-focused)

  • Apply performance data to iterate and improve ad creatives week over week
  • Deliver assets fast we move quickly and expect tight turnaround when needed


How to apply?

Apply directly via LinkedIn

Attach your resume and portfolio of previous works

  • We’re looking to hire immediately — so if you’re an editor who gets performance, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Company Description

United Hub Digital (UHD) is a nearshore IT consulting firm helping mid and large US enterprise clients accelerate their data and technology initiatives. Headquartered in Greenville, SC, with a delivery hub in Brazil, we embed directly into client teams as a trusted execution partner across data analytics, software development, UI/UX, and project management. We hold ourselves to the same standards of accountability and delivery quality our clients expect from their own teams.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help one of our enterprise clients unlock the value of their data for AI-driven use cases. The goal focus for this role is to 'make the data AI-ready': well-structured, semantically rich, documented, and governed.

Your primary output is a clean, well-documented, and semantically meaningful data environment that downstream AI workloads can reason over reliably.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

What You Will Do

Semantic Modeling

  • Design and build semantic layers that translate raw ERP tables into business-meaningful domains (finance, procurement, supply chain, etc.)
  • Define and enforce naming conventions, metric definitions, and business logic in a shared, governed layer
  • Work with Databricks semantic layer to expose curated datasets for AI and analytics consumption


Data Documentation and Context

  • Produce column-level documentation, data dictionaries, and business glossaries inside Unity Catalog
  • Establish lineage tracing from source system tables through to consumption-ready datasets
  • Collaborate with source systems stakeholders to capture domain knowledge and translate it into structured metadata


AI Readiness

  • Structure data to support LLM-based and ML workloads, including RAG pipelines and structured querying
  • Identify and address data quality gaps that would undermine AI model reliability
  • Define thematic data domains and organize datasets to give AI systems the right context and scope


Governance and Quality

  • Implement data quality rules and freshness monitors using Databricks tooling
  • Tag sensitive fields and support data access tier definitions within Unity Catalog
  • Own documentation standards and ensure the catalog remains accurate as data evolves

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years in analytics engineering, data architecture, or a closely related discipline
  • Hands-on Databricks expertise: Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, cluster configuration, and query optimization
  • Experience with semantic modeling tools, ideally dbt (dbt Core or dbt Cloud)
  • Strong SQL and a solid understanding of data modeling patterns (star schema, medallion architecture, etc.)
  • Ability to read and interpret unfamiliar data models quickly, including ERP-sourced data structures
  • Experience writing technical documentation that non-technical stakeholders can act on


Nice to Have

  • Exposure to Databricks AI/BI, Genie, or Vector Search
  • Experience supporting ML or LLM-based downstream use cases
  • Background in data mesh or domain-oriented data architecture

title: CSOD
description:
About NIIT


At NIIT, we’re transforming the way the world learns, for the better. That’s why the world’s best run learning functions across the globe trust us with their learning and talent. Since 1981, we have helped leading companies transform their learning ecosystems while increasing the business value of learning. Our comprehensive, high impact managed learning solutions weave together the best of learning theory, technology, operations, and services to enable a thriving workforce.

NIIT operates in over 40 countries, including the UK, Ireland, France and Germany. Due to rapid expansion in Europe, the company now seeks a new dynamic Business Development Director to significantly increase sales to Fortune 500 companies across Europe.


Link to NIIT LinkedIn page -


Title : CSOD Implementation consultant


Job Description:


We are seeking an experienced Compensation Expert with strong expertise in Cornerstone OnDemand (CSOD)

Serve as a course implementation expert to our primarily partners to help drive our course deployments

  • Understand and apply comprehensive learning operations knowledge to execute effective course deployment strategies to global audiences.
  • Strong and effective in written, verbal, and presentation skills
  • Analyze and provide recommendations to address existing problems.
  • Develops creative solutions in preparation for unforeseen issues.
  • Apply analytical and critical thinking skills quickly and accurately in a high-pressure situation
  • Detail-oriented, data-driven, and customer-focused professional who can pivot priorities based on changing business needs
  • Support our internal community by driving impact through collaborative working relationships
  • Be able to network with, and appropriately identify and involve key internal stakeholders to influence outcomes in cross-functional settings
  • Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and working within the context of a new team in the process of building out an operations program
  • Operate independently in fast moving, stressful situations while managing mission critical tasks
  • Anticipate needs before being asked, identify opportunities to improve processes and create efficiencies
  • Be able to handle multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing workloads to meet competing deadlines
  • Provide clear and constant communication and escalate issues in a timely manner

Responsibilities:

  • Maintain project plan and complete operational processes and deliverables to help ensure effective, trouble-free e-Learn and in-person course launches to our targeted audiences
  • Actively and effectively partner with L&D Program Managers and SMEs to support new and ongoing course deployments
  • Document and provide course deployment requirements (e.g. reoccurrence) which informs the correct course configurations and assignment of course curriculums
  • Draft and maintain course playbooks, key deployment changes, course requirements, and other standard operating procedure documents
  • Track and report course key metrics and performance measures to key stakeholder as required
  • Drive course impact by leveraging data to implement best practices that increase enrollment, discoverability, and consumption of our learning content
  • Develop and document effective course communication escalation strategies to help drive compliance course completions
  • Provide oversight for e-Learning course maintenance, ILT event management, class session forecasting, group / target audience assignments, and learner enrollments for all assigned programs
  • Prepare and facilitate course quarterly business review meetings with stakeholders
  • Provide course learner support for assigned courses by resolving issues or routing cases to appropriate team members to resolve
  • Work with People Operations, Engineering (Eng), People Insights, and Data teams to root cause potential LMS, reporting, or learner support issues
  • Drive the execution of all learning related audit control testing and support any operational audit initiatives
  • Identify and communicate system and process issues to L&D and make recommendations on programs to drive operational efficiencies


NIIT is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Editor de Matemática
description:
A Saber faz parte do Grupo Cogna Educação, uma das principais organizações educacionais do mundo. Nossas soluções abrangem o ambiente virtual completo de aprendizagem, tutoria especializada, material pedagógico, amplo portfólio de cursos, atendimento ao estudante, BackOffice de pagamento e monitoramento da jornada de alunos.

Nesta vaga você irá atuar no Programa Nacional de Livros Didáticos (PNLD ) com as editoras Ática, Saraiva e Scipione , com a oferta de livros didáticos para mais de 118 mil escolas públicas em todo o país. É uma super oportunidade de mudar a educação no Brasil para melhor! #AquiéCogna


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


• Editar obras das Editoras Ática, Saraiva e Scipione na área de Matemática para o atendimento de editais de venda pública nos diversos segmentos da Educação Básica (Ensino Fundamental I, Ensino Fundamental II e Ensino Médio), verificando a correção, a atualização e a qualidade dos conteúdos da área, a clareza do texto, a adequação das ilustrações e das atividades, bem como reduzindo erros e retrabalhos.

• Dar suporte ao Editor responsável durante toda a produção.

• Elaborar, quando necessário, conteúdos, atividades e seções para o Livro do Estudante, além de orientações didáticas para o Manual do Professor.

• Elaborar ou orientar a elaboração de pautas de imagem, fotografia, cartografia, ilustração, entre outros pedidos.

• Liberar provas de mapas, gráficos e ilustrações, selecionar e aprovar imagens de acordo com a orientação autoral e as regras estabelecidas pelos Editais do PNLD.

• Acompanhar a execução de tarefas feitas por editores freelancers.

• Liberar e acompanhar a liberação de provas com o controle de pendências de iconografia, cartografia, ilustração e textos de terceiros.

• Assegurar o cumprimento do projeto gráfico proposta para a obra, os prazos e a qualidade diferenciada.

• Apoiar integralmente os fechamentos de todos os produtos da área.


Requisitos e qualificações:

• Formação em Licenciatura e/ou Bacharelado em Matemática.

• Profissional atualizado em relação aos conhecimentos de sua área de formação e de atuação;

• Importante ter conhecimento de documentos relacionados ao sistema educacional brasileiro, como BNCC, Editais de programas anteriores, pesquisas recentes nas áreas de Matemática e de educação;

• Conhecimento das ferramentas Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint);

• Conhecimento das ferramentas ADOBE e Acrobat Pro;

• Conhecimento de software de edição de Matemática (Mathtype e Equation).\" -

• Capacidade de comunicação clara e objetiva, proatividade, flexibilidade e organização.


Informações adicionais:

Atuação remota.


O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.


Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.

title: Analista Fiscal
description:
Vaga: Analista Fiscal Sênior


Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Fiscal Sênior com sólida experiência e forte domínio da legislação tributária brasileira para integrar nossa equipe fiscal. Este profissional será responsável por garantir a precisão, conformidade e eficiência dos processos fiscais , atuando de forma estratégica e técnica em todas as etapas da área.



Conciliação contábil, fechamento mensal, apuração de impostos, atendimento à auditoria e elaboração de demonstrações financeiras.


Principais responsabilidades:

• Apuração completa de tributos diretos e indiretos (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, IRPJ, CSLL );

• Elaboração e entrega das obrigações acessórias (SPED Fiscal, SPED Contribuições, EFD-Reinf, DCTF, DIRF, entre outras);

• Análise e validação de documentos fiscais de entrada, saída e serviços;

• Atendimento a fiscalizações e auditorias externas ;

• Acompanhamento e interpretação da legislação fiscal e tributária , garantindo atualização contínua dos processos internos;

• Apoio técnico e atendimento consultivo a clientes em temas fiscais.


Requisitos:

• Formação superior em Contabilidade ;

• Experiência sólida na área fiscal ;

• Conhecimento aprofundado em Lucro Real, Lucro Presumido e Simples Nacional ;

• Domínio de Excel avançado e boa capacidade analítica;


Diferenciais que valorizamos:

• Inglês intermediário ou avançado;

• Experiência com o sistema ERP Domínio ;

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI aplicadas à gestão fiscal.

• MES (Manufacturing Engineering System) for Pharma industry

• GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) - Knowledge of manufacturing and quality processes in GMP environments


And much better if you stand out for:

  • Coordinate technical aspects of MES, including system interfaces, enhancements, and integration with IT infrastructure and engineering teams.

  • Roadmap Management
  • Manage and prioritize MES projects in partnership with business stakeholders (Manufacturing, Quality, IT).

  • Perform testing to demonstrate viability of solutions. Requires experience with GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) procedures.
  • Support audits, CAPAs, and regulatory inspections related to PAS-X and manufacturing data integrity.
  • System Operations
  • Support electronic batch record (MBR) design, deployment, and troubleshooting.
  • Provide technical support for front-end and back-end PAS-X configuration (users, master data, printers, scales, terminals, etc.).
  • Oversee ServiceNow or equivalent ticketing system for MES incidents, changes, and escalations.
  • Deliver training and guidance to MES users and support personnel.
  • Engage and drive vendor support as required.


Key Words:

  • Korber Pharma Werum PAS-X MES
  • MES (Manufacturing Engineering System) for Pharma industry

title: CSOD
description:
About NIIT


At NIIT, we’re transforming the way the world learns, for the better. That’s why the world’s best run learning functions across the globe trust us with their learning and talent. Since 1981, we have helped leading companies transform their learning ecosystems while increasing the business value of learning. Our comprehensive, high impact managed learning solutions weave together the best of learning theory, technology, operations, and services to enable a thriving workforce.

NIIT operates in over 40 countries, including the UK, Ireland, France and Germany. Due to rapid expansion in Europe, the company now seeks a new dynamic Business Development Director to significantly increase sales to Fortune 500 companies across Europe.


Link to NIIT LinkedIn page -


Title : CSOD Implementation consultant


Job Description:


We are seeking an experienced Compensation Expert with strong expertise in Cornerstone OnDemand (CSOD)

Serve as a course implementation expert to our primarily partners to help drive our course deployments

  • Understand and apply comprehensive learning operations knowledge to execute effective course deployment strategies to global audiences.
  • Strong and effective in written, verbal, and presentation skills
  • Analyze and provide recommendations to address existing problems.
  • Develops creative solutions in preparation for unforeseen issues.
  • Apply analytical and critical thinking skills quickly and accurately in a high-pressure situation
  • Detail-oriented, data-driven, and customer-focused professional who can pivot priorities based on changing business needs
  • Support our internal community by driving impact through collaborative working relationships
  • Be able to network with, and appropriately identify and involve key internal stakeholders to influence outcomes in cross-functional settings
  • Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and working within the context of a new team in the process of building out an operations program
  • Operate independently in fast moving, stressful situations while managing mission critical tasks
  • Anticipate needs before being asked, identify opportunities to improve processes and create efficiencies
  • Be able to handle multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing workloads to meet competing deadlines
  • Provide clear and constant communication and escalate issues in a timely manner

Responsibilities:

  • Maintain project plan and complete operational processes and deliverables to help ensure effective, trouble-free e-Learn and in-person course launches to our targeted audiences
  • Actively and effectively partner with L&D Program Managers and SMEs to support new and ongoing course deployments
  • Document and provide course deployment requirements (e.g. reoccurrence) which informs the correct course configurations and assignment of course curriculums
  • Draft and maintain course playbooks, key deployment changes, course requirements, and other standard operating procedure documents
  • Track and report course key metrics and performance measures to key stakeholder as required
  • Drive course impact by leveraging data to implement best practices that increase enrollment, discoverability, and consumption of our learning content
  • Develop and document effective course communication escalation strategies to help drive compliance course completions
  • Provide oversight for e-Learning course maintenance, ILT event management, class session forecasting, group / target audience assignments, and learner enrollments for all assigned programs
  • Prepare and facilitate course quarterly business review meetings with stakeholders
  • Provide course learner support for assigned courses by resolving issues or routing cases to appropriate team members to resolve
  • Work with People Operations, Engineering (Eng), People Insights, and Data teams to root cause potential LMS, reporting, or learner support issues
  • Drive the execution of all learning related audit control testing and support any operational audit initiatives
  • Identify and communicate system and process issues to L&D and make recommendations on programs to drive operational efficiencies


NIIT is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

A Saber faz parte do Grupo Cogna Educação, uma das principais organizações educacionais do mundo. Nossas soluções abrangem o ambiente virtual completo de aprendizagem, tutoria especializada, material pedagógico, amplo portfólio de cursos, atendimento ao estudante, BackOffice de pagamento e monitoramento da jornada de alunos.

Nesta vaga você irá atuar no Programa Nacional de Livros Didáticos (PNLD ) com as editoras Ática, Saraiva e Scipione , com a oferta de livros didáticos para mais de 118 mil escolas públicas em todo o país. É uma super oportunidade de mudar a educação no Brasil para melhor! #AquiéCogna

title: FX Trader
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

This company operates within an AWS environment which is supported by their DevOps team; however, any cloud integration experience could be helpful.


This position is currently slated as a 6-month contract, with high likelihood to extend for an additional 6+ months. Furthermore, this organization has a large pipeline of project work for the next three years, so continuous extensions are likely.

** This role can pay up to $5,000 USD monthly

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Senior Financial Analyst


Location: Remote (Brazil)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to support reporting, billing processes, and revenue operations. This role will play a critical part in ensuring financial accuracy, optimizing workflows, and delivering insights that drive business performance as the organization scales.



Position Overview


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst to support financial operations, reporting, and billing processes. This role will act as a key partner across Finance, Sales, and Customer Success teams, ensuring alignment between contracts, invoicing, and revenue recognition. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with hands-on experience in billing, revenue operations, and financial reporting. This role requires both strategic insight and operational execution, contributing to process improvements and supporting the company’s financial health and scalability.



What You'll Do:


  • Analyze financial performance, identify trends, and deliver actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
  • Enhance financial reporting, tools, and processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability
  • Ensure customer contracts are aligned with invoicing terms and revenue recognition policies
  • Prepare and process invoices accurately and in a timely manner, resolving discrepancies when needed
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to ensure billing accuracy and proper contract implementation
  • Monitor accounts receivable, track outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments
  • Maintain accurate billing records and supporting documentation for audits and reporting
  • Contribute to optimizing and streamlining the quote-to-cash process
  • Support financial reporting cycles and assist with audits related to billing and revenue operations
  • Perform ad-hoc financial analysis and support additional finance-related initiatives.



What You Bring:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • 4–7+ years of experience in financial analysis, billing, accounting, or revenue operations
  • Strong understanding of invoicing processes, revenue recognition principles, and financial reporting
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with ERP or financial systems is a plus
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills
  • High attention to detail with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to translate financial data into clear, actionable insights.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with billing or subscription-based business models
  • Familiarity with quote-to-cash processes
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance processes
  • Background in process optimization and financial systems improvements
  • Experience working in high-growth or scaling organizations.


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern financial systems and tools
  • High-impact role supporting financial strategy and operations
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.


Please ensure that your application, including your CV, is submitted in English, as this is a requirement for the recruitment process.

title: Applications Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) ServiceNow Applications Engineer com forte expertise em AppEngine , desenvolvimento de aplicações customizadas e automação de processos, para atuar em um ambiente altamente técnico e colaborativo.

O(a) profissional será responsável por liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento, governança de plataforma e soluções de automação industrial, combinando visão estratégica, excelência técnica e interação com múltiplas áreas do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e workflows customizados em ServiceNow (AppEngine, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub)
  • Projetar soluções escaláveis, seguras e aderentes às melhores práticas da plataforma
  • Integrar ServiceNow com sistemas externos via REST/SOAP
  • Criar e manter Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs e UI Policies
  • Orientar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, incluindo code reviews e mentoring
  • Garantir governança da plataforma, reusabilidade e qualidade técnica das entregas
  • Desenvolver e sustentar aplicações de processo e automação industrial, utilizando tecnologias de Controle Avançado e Otimizadores em tempo real
  • Participar de projetos estratégicos, atuando como referência técnica e colaborando em melhorias cross-funcionais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Inglês avançado/fluente
  • Experiência sólida com:
  • JavaScript
  • ServiceNow AppEngine
  • Flow Designer
  • Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs, UI Policies
  • Integrações via REST/SOAP
  • Experiência com HRSD, S2P e outros módulos/plugins ServiceNow
  • Vivência com DevOps, ATF e GitHub
  • Experiência em automação industrial / controle de processos
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de refino e processos químicos
  • Experiência com Multivariable Predictive Control (AspenTech DMC, Honeywell RMPCT)
  • Experiência com Real-Time Optimizers (RoMeo ou similares)


Diferenciais

  • Certificações ServiceNow:
  • Flow Designer
  • IntegrationHub
  • Automated Test Framework
  • Service Portal
  • Performance Analytics
  • CSA (Certified System Administrator)
  • CAD (Certified Application Developer)
  • CIS (Certified Implementation Specialist)
  • CTA (Certified Technical Architect)


Onde você vai trabalhar?

100% remoto. No conforto de sua casa.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Global Networks Leader
description:
Purpose


As the Global Network Operations Leader, you will oversee the comprehensive management and direction of our network operations, ensuring optimal performance and reliability on a global scale. This critical role involves managing a managed service partner to deliver superior network operations and support services.


Main Responsibilities


Oversee the day-to-day network operations, including monitoring, maintenance, and incident response, to ensure high availability and performance.


Oversee the escalation process, ensuring timely resolution of critical network issues and minimizing impact on business operations.


Supervise routine maintenance activities, ensuring they are conducted efficiently and effectively to prevent unplanned downtime and extend the life of network assets.


Lead change management processes for network operations, including planning, approval, and implementation of network changes to ensure minimal disruption and adherence to best practices.


Act as the primary liaison with our managed service partner, ensuring they meet or exceed service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs).


Continuously assess and improve network performance, reliability, and security, leveraging data and analytics to drive decision-making.


Innovation and Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements and technology enhancements, leading initiatives to implement innovative solutions.


Develop and implement risk management strategies to mitigate potential network disruptions and ensure business continuity.


Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, providing regular updates on network performance, issues, and improvements.


Ensure compliance with relevant Orbia infrastructure standards, regulations, and security protocols to protect the organization's network infrastructure. Take care of regular audits.


Knowledge and experience requiered


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
  • Language(s) and level of proficiency: English (fluent) and Spanish
  • In-depth knowledge of network infrastructure technologies, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and network monitoring tools.
  • Proficiency in network protocols, such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, and MPLS.
  • Experience with network security best practices and technologies, including VPNs, IDS/IPS, and network access control.
  • Familiarity with cloud networking and hybrid cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with deploying, configuring, and testing network equipment.
  • Familiarity with automation tools and scripting (e.g., Ansible, Python).


Management & communication Skills


  • Experience in managing relationships with MSP, vendors and suppliers.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with internal stakeholders (e.g., operations, finance, senior management).


Relevant Experience


  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in network operations management, with at least 5 years in a leadership role overseeing global network operations.
  • Extensive experience working with and managing relationships with managed service partners.
  • Relevant certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent are highly desirable.
  • ITIL certification is a plus.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior Data Engineer with 5+ years of experience to join our U.S. client's software engineering team. This key individual should have experience making decisions, working on a small development team, and working both independently and as part of a small, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference.

The industry-leading client provides business-automating, enterprise resource planning (ERP) accounting software for the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across 9 countries.

The senior-level position will be part of the client's Intelligence team. This business intelligence solution brings data from multiple products onto one platform, enabling analysis and data-driven insights. Responsibilities will focus on designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and infrastructure that converts raw data into a format ready for ingestion by a BI tool. The individual will coordinate with the implementation team to provide on-time deliverables, quality products, and exceptional customer service.


Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain scalable data pipelines that power clients' products, which support core product functionality, customer reporting, and internal analytics.

  • Develop, optimize, and manage SQL view scripts and transformations.
  • Design, configure, and maintain database architectures, distributed systems, and data storage solutions.
  • Ensure data integrity by implementing validation processes for data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and optimize data queries and workflows for efficiency.
  • Build and support data integrations with internal services and third‑party APIs, managing authentication, schema evolution, rate limits, and error handling. Proactively adapt pipelines as client products and customer needs grow.
  • Research and recommend innovative approaches for project execution. Recommend areas for improvement in internal processes along with possible solutions, providing status reports to stakeholders, and addressing issues as appropriate.
  • Participate with the team in problem resolution regarding systems and procedures. Assists the team or supervisor in identifying data anomalies and providing business solutions.
  • Document procedures using text, workflow diagrams, and screenshots from the application. Develops and maintains installations and configuration procedures. Provides documentation for institutional workflow processes associated with the application.


Required Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, or related field
  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
  • 5+ years of data engineering experience
  • 3+ years SQL and Python experience
  • Knowledge of database architecture and management
  • Experience working with Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP, etc.)
  • Ability to read code and convert programming logic from one language to another
  • Familiarity with APIs


Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with data analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, QuickSight, Looker, Sisense)
  • Experience with Apache Airflow
  • Experience with AI coding tools and/or AI assistants
  • Background in Math, Stats, Machine Learning


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

description:
Company Description

MillionLogics is a trusted Oracle Partner and a global leader in innovative IT solutions, with offices in London, UK, and a state-of-the-art development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specializes in transformative, future-ready solutions, including Data & AI, Cloud migrations, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimization, with a strong focus on Oracle Cloud and database technologies. Backed by over 45+ technology experts and led by visionary leadership, MillionLogics delivers tailored and results-driven technology solutions. Committed to empowering organizations worldwide, the company embraces innovation and excellence to drive digital transformation. To learn more, visit: millionlogics.com.


Role Overview

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.


Offer Details :

  • Contract Duration : 12 months
  • Pay : US $200 (take-home) per task
  • Experience : 3+ years
  • Positions : 98
  • Work Mode : Remote


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  •  Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.


Domain Tracks

  • You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the following; expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.
  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.
  • Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference.
  • Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads.
  • Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design.
  • Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design.
  • Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration.
  • Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration.


Required Qualification:

  • Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis).
  • Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain.
  • Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills.
  • High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism.


Nice to Have

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process

  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round.


How to Apply: Please send us your updated CV to with Job ID- 72123 as your email subject.
