title: Coordenador administrativo
description:
Vaga: Coordenador(a) Administrativo e Financeiro
(Braço direito da Diretoria)
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional para atuar como braço direito da diretoria, com responsabilidade sobre a organização, controle e evolução das áreas Administrativa, Financeira e de RH.
Buscamos alguém com senso de dono, visão de negócio e capacidade de estruturar processos que tragam clareza, previsibilidade e eficiência para a empresa.
⸻
Principais responsabilidades
• Estruturar e organizar os processos administrativos da empresa
• Gerenciar o fluxo financeiro (contas a pagar/receber, conciliação, controle de caixa)
• Garantir previsibilidade financeira e qualidade das informações
• Apoiar a diretoria na tomada de decisão com base em dados
• Criar e acompanhar indicadores (KPIs) financeiros e operacionais
• Atuar como ponte com a contabilidade externa
• Apoiar e organizar rotinas de RH (admissão, desligamento, benefícios e suporte ao time)
• Identificar gargalos e implementar melhorias nos processos
• Apoiar na implantação das propostas de Plano de Saude
• Padronizar rotinas administrativas e financeiras
⸻
O que buscamos
• Perfil altamente organizado, analítico e confiável
• Capacidade de estruturar e controlar operação administrativa e financeira
• Senso de dono e proatividade
• Maturidade para lidar com informações estratégicas e confidenciais
• Boa comunicação e relacionamento com diferentes áreas
• Experiência prévia em rotinas administrativas e financeiras
Diferenciais
• Experiência com organização financeira de empresas
• Vivência com estruturação de processos do zero
• Experiência em empresas de serviços (consultoria, seguros, benefícios, etc.)
• Conhecimento em indicadores e gestão por números
• Experiência com rotinas de RH generalista
Modelo de contratação
• Contratação PJ
• Remuneração: A combinar

title: Coordenador de desenvolvimento de software (remoto)
description:
Sobre a Arauc:
Aqui na Arauc transformamos ideias em software, viabilizando o empreendedorismo com startups e digitalizando operações de empresas estabelecidas. Desenvolvemos desde aplicativos mobile e sistemas web até arquiteturas em nuvem, automações e Inteligência Artificial. Somos uma empresa jovem em crescimento, com projetos em diferentes setores e um ambiente que valoriza inovação, autonomia e aprendizado constante.
O Desafio:
Para continuarmos entregando produtos digitais de excelência, buscamos um Coordenador de Desenvolvimento de Software (REMOTO) apaixonado por tecnologia, com forte visão de produto e focado em resultados. Você será o líder técnico dos nossos projetos, atuando de ponta a ponta: desde a concepção e arquitetura até o deploy, testes e garantia de qualidade. Se você gosta de colocar a mão na massa, gerenciar o fluxo de desenvolvimento da equipe, criar MVPs inovadores e atuar em projetos robustos para grandes empresas, esse é o lugar!
Responsabilidades
Liderar o ciclo de vida completo do software, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade do início ao fim do projeto.
Desenhar a arquitetura das soluções e elaborar documentações técnicas que sirvam de guia claro para a equipe.
Planejar sprints, gerenciar o fluxo de tarefas e acompanhar a evolução técnica dos desenvolvedores.
Assegurar a qualidade do produto final através de revisão de código, rotinas de testes e validação rigorosa das entregas.
Atuar ativamente no código (Full Stack) para acelerar desenvolvimentos críticos ou resolver gargalos técnicos da equipe. Qualificações
Habilidade em planejamento de desenvolvimento de software, gestão de desenvolvedores e garantia de entregas.
Sólida experiência como Desenvolvedor Full Stack.
Forte conhecimento prático em Arquitetura de Software e Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Firebase).
Visão de testes e qualidade de código.
Capacidade de transitar entre o planejamento e a execução técnica.
Comunicação clara para alinhar expectativas com a equipe de desenvolvimento e stakeholders.
Perfil de dono: você assume a responsabilidade de amarrar todas as pontas do projeto para garantir o sucesso final. Desejável
Experiência prévia atuando como Tech Lead ou liderando equipes técnicas.
Vivência em ambientes dinâmicos de startups e metodologias ágeis.
Noções de negócios e produto. Diferencial da Vaga
Modelo de Parceria nos Resultados: Além da remuneração, você receberá bônus atrelados à performance dos MVPs desenvolvidos. Você receberá bonus percentual atrelado com o lucro líquido dos MVPs desenvolvidos. Uma excelente oportunidade para quem gosta de resolver desafios técnicos complexos, atuar de ponta a ponta no desenvolvimento e ter impacto direto na qualidade e no sucesso dos produtos que construímos.

title: Virtual assistant
description:
Virtual Assistant - Fully Remote
About the job:
We are looking for someone who will help our team with various tasks, has excellent written and spoken English skills, and is attentive to detail and organized.
You will be given various tasks to perform, but your major role is to help us with some marketing activities for our agency and our clients. You will be responsible for crafting and sending personalized outreach messages, reporting, creating Canva designs and working with videos, scheduling posts, scheduling meetings, downloading and cleaning databases, and more. Full training is provided.
This is a full-time role Mon-Fri for 40 hours per week with occasional overtime. Work time from 9:30am – 6.00pm New York Time (with a 30-minute break). You will be working with US clients, but you can live outside of the US; therefore, we would like to have someone in our team who knows American Culture and speaks decent English. Experience with appointment setting, understanding a fitness niche and/or having a sales/ business/ marketing background is an advantage. The company may offer growth opportunities depending on performance.
Requirements:
Strong English skills, a neutral accent, and familiarity with American culture.
Commitment to working 9:30am – 6.00pm New York Time.
Excellent communication and organizational skills.
Passion for digital marketing and a hunger to learn.
Experience in marketing or fitness is a bonus, but not required.
Attention to detail is a must (!!!>> When filling out the form, put your postcode as G9999, DO NOT put your real postcode
Enjoy long-term stability and 100% remote.
Join a supportive team.
Get top-notch training in marketing and beyond.
Starting at $600/month with performance bonuses as you grow.

title: Virtual assistant
description:
Virtual Assistant - Fully Remote
About the job:
We are looking for someone who will help our team with various tasks, has excellent written and spoken English skills, and is attentive to detail and organized.
You will be given various tasks to perform, but your major role is to help us with some marketing activities for our agency and our clients. You will be responsible for crafting and sending personalized outreach messages, reporting, creating Canva designs and working with videos, scheduling posts, scheduling meetings, downloading and cleaning databases, and more. Full training is provided.
This is a full-time role Mon-Fri for 40 hours per week with occasional overtime. Work time from 9:30am – 6.00pm New York Time (with a 30-minute break). You will be working with US clients, but you can live outside of the US; therefore, we would like to have someone in our team who knows American Culture and speaks decent English. Experience with appointment setting, understanding a fitness niche and/or having a sales/ business/ marketing background is an advantage. The company may offer growth opportunities depending on performance.

Strong English skills, a neutral accent, and familiarity with American culture.
Commitment to working 9:30am – 6.00pm New York Time.
Excellent communication and organizational skills.
Passion for digital marketing and a hunger to learn.
Experience in marketing or fitness is a bonus, but not required.

Enjoy long-term stability and 100% remote.
Join a supportive team.
Get top-notch training in marketing and beyond.

title: Desenvolvedor fullstack - remoto
description:
Sobre a Arauc:
Aqui na Arauc transformamos ideias em software, viabilizando o empreendedorismo com startups e digitalizando operações de empresas estabelecidas. Desenvolvemos desde aplicativos mobile e sistemas web até arquiteturas em nuvem, automações e Inteligência Artificial. Somos uma empresa jovem em crescimento, com projetos em diferentes setores e um ambiente que valoriza inovação, autonomia e aprendizado constante.
O Desafio:
Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Full Stack - (Remoto) para atuar na construção de sistemas completos e MVPs.
Buscamos pessoas proativas, curiosas e apaixonadas por programação, que queiram crescer junto com a gente e deixar sua marca em produtos usados por milhares de pessoas.
Se você quer evoluir rápido, aprender na prática e trabalhar em projetos variados, esse é o lugar.
Responsabilidades
Desenvolver aplicações completas (front-end + back-end + cloud + deploy)
Participar da construção de MVPs do zero até produção
Implementar interfaces (web/mobile) e integrações com APIs
Trabalhar com banco de dados e lógica de backend
Fazer deploy e gerenciar aplicações em nuvem
Garantir qualidade básica do código e funcionamento das entregas
Colaborar na evolução dos produtos e melhorias contínuas Qualificações
Conhecimento em desenvolvimento Full Stack
Familiaridade com pelo menos uma stack web
Noções de banco de dados
Conhecimento básico de cloud (AWS, GCP ou Firebase)
Capacidade de aprender rápido e se virar com problemas novos
Boa comunicação e organização Desejável
Já ter desenvolvido projetos próprios ou MVPs
Experiência com deploy de aplicações
Noção de produto
Interesse em startups e construção de soluções do zero Diferencial da Vaga

Uma excelente oportunidade para desenvolvedores que gostam de desafios, de trabalhar em diferentes projetos, aprender novas tecnologias e evoluir profissionalmente!

title: Csod
description:
About NIIT
At NIIT, we're transforming the way the world learns, for the better. That's why the world's best run learning functions across the globe trust us with their learning and talent. Since 1981, we have helped leading companies transform their learning ecosystems while increasing the business value of learning. Our comprehensive, high impact managed learning solutions weave together the best of learning theory, technology, operations, and services to enable a thriving workforce.
NIIT operates in over 40 countries, including the UK, Ireland, France and Germany. Due to rapid expansion in Europe, the company now seeks a new dynamic Business Development Director to significantly increase sales to Fortune 500 companies across Europe.
Link to NIIT Linked In page -
Title: CSOD Implementation consultant
Job Description:
We are seeking an experienced Compensation Expert with strong expertise in Cornerstone On Demand (CSOD)
Serve as a course implementation expert to our primarily partners to help drive our course deployments
Understand and apply comprehensive learning operations knowledge to execute effective course deployment strategies to global audiences.
Strong and effective in written, verbal, and presentation skills
Analyze and provide recommendations to address existing problems.
Develops creative solutions in preparation for unforeseen issues.
Apply analytical and critical thinking skills quickly and accurately in a high-pressure situation
Detail-oriented, data-driven, and customer-focused professional who can pivot priorities based on changing business needs
Support our internal community by driving impact through collaborative working relationships
Be able to network with, and appropriately identify and involve key internal stakeholders to influence outcomes in cross-functional settings
Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and working within the context of a new team in the process of building out an operations program
Operate independently in fast moving, stressful situations while managing mission critical tasks
Anticipate needs before being asked, identify opportunities to improve processes and create efficiencies
Be able to handle multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing workloads to meet competing deadlines
Provide clear and constant communication and escalate issues in a timely manner Responsibilities:
Maintain project plan and complete operational processes and deliverables to help ensure effective, trouble-free e-Learn and in-person course launches to our targeted audiences
Actively and effectively partner with L& D Program Managers and SMEs to support new and ongoing course deployments
Document and provide course deployment requirements (e.g. reoccurrence) which informs the correct course configurations and assignment of course curriculums
Draft and maintain course playbooks, key deployment changes, course requirements, and other standard operating procedure documents
Track and report course key metrics and performance measures to key stakeholder as required
Drive course impact by leveraging data to implement best practices that increase enrollment, discoverability, and consumption of our learning content
Develop and document effective course communication escalation strategies to help drive compliance course completions
Provide oversight for e-Learning course maintenance, ILT event management, class session forecasting, group / target audience assignments, and learner enrollments for all assigned programs
Prepare and facilitate course quarterly business review meetings with stakeholders
Provide course learner support for assigned courses by resolving issues or routing cases to appropriate team members to resolve
Work with People Operations, Engineering (Eng), People Insights, and Data teams to root cause potential LMS, reporting, or learner support issues
Drive the execution of all learning related audit control testing and support any operational audit initiatives
Identify and communicate system and process issues to L& D and make recommendations on programs to drive operational efficiencies NIIT is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Llm scientist
description:
We are looking for an \"LLM Scientist\" for our client, an international AI development company based in New York, who will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, enhancing the quality of data and the efficiency of data pipelines, and contribute to a team culture that values mentorship and knowledge sharing.
Key Responsibilities
Design and execute experiments by conducting ablation studies on various prompt strategies, tokenization methods, and fine-tuning hyperparameters.
Own model decisions regarding the selection of foundation models for specific tasks and the acceptable trade-offs between latency and accuracy.
Architect data pipelines in collaboration with Data Engineers to curate high-quality synthetic data and improve model training efficiency.
Solve complex 'hallucination' problems by serving as the final escalation point for enhancing model factuality and designing logic for retrievers and re-rankers.
Mentor the team by translating the latest research papers into actionable engineering tickets.
Qualification Required
Extensive experience with Py Torch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, Accelerate).
Proven track record of fine-tuning models, with a deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional embeddings, and transformer architectures.
Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and familiarity with the mathematics behind similarity search and embedding models.
Proficiency in Python, along with familiarity in containerization (Docker) and cloud-scale Al training (AWS Sage Maker/GCP Vertex Al).
Ability to analyze model failures, hypothesize root causes, and systematically test solutions.
Nice to Have
Advanced Degree: A Master's or Ph D in Computer Science, Math, or a related field with a focus on NLP.
Multi-Modal Experience: Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLM) or audio-to-text integration.
Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization).
Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public Git Hub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the Gen Al space.
Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization.
About Our Client
Our client is a people-focused organization dedicated to developing impactful products and services that create meaningful value for customers and communities. They foster a collaborative, respectful, and inclusive work environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow professionally. The company supports flexibility and work–life balance while maintaining strong performance and accountability standards.
Benefits & Wellbeing
Compensation for this role is determined based on competitive market data and may vary depending on geographic location, experience, skills, and qualifications. Specific details will be discussed during the interview process.
The company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' well-being, financial security, and professional development. Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plan contributions, paid time off, flexible working arrangements, and opportunities for career growth, in accordance with company policies and applicable local regulations. It is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country of employment.

title: Forensic manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.
Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.
Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group's investigative objectives.
In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.
To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.
While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.

title: Llm scientist
description:
We are looking for an \"LLM Scientist\" for our client, an international AI development company based in New York, who will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, enhancing the quality of data and the efficiency of data pipelines, and contribute to a team culture that values mentorship and knowledge sharing.
Key Responsibilities
Design and execute experiments by conducting ablation studies on various prompt strategies, tokenization methods, and fine-tuning hyperparameters.
Own model decisions regarding the selection of foundation models for specific tasks and the acceptable trade-offs between latency and accuracy.
Architect data pipelines in collaboration with Data Engineers to curate high-quality synthetic data and improve model training efficiency.
Solve complex 'hallucination' problems by serving as the final escalation point for enhancing model factuality and designing logic for retrievers and re-rankers.
Mentor the team by translating the latest research papers into actionable engineering tickets.
Qualification Required
Extensive experience with Py Torch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, Accelerate).
Proven track record of fine-tuning models, with a deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional embeddings, and transformer architectures.
Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and familiarity with the mathematics behind similarity search and embedding models.
Proficiency in Python, along with familiarity in containerization (Docker) and cloud-scale Al training (AWS Sage Maker/GCP Vertex Al).
Ability to analyze model failures, hypothesize root causes, and systematically test solutions.
Nice to Have
Advanced Degree: A Master's or Ph D in Computer Science, Math, or a related field with a focus on NLP.
Multi-Modal Experience: Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLM) or audio-to-text integration.
Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization).
Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public Git Hub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the Gen Al space.
Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization.
About Our Client
Our client is a people-focused organization dedicated to developing impactful products and services that create meaningful value for customers and communities. They foster a collaborative, respectful, and inclusive work environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow professionally. The company supports flexibility and work–life balance while maintaining strong performance and accountability standards.
Benefits & Wellbeing
Compensation for this role is determined based on competitive market data and may vary depending on geographic location, experience, skills, and qualifications. Specific details will be discussed during the interview process.
The company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' well-being, financial security, and professional development. Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plan contributions, paid time off, flexible working arrangements, and opportunities for career growth, in accordance with company policies and applicable local regulations. It is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country of employment.

title: Forensic manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.
Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.
Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group's investigative objectives.
In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.
To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.
While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.
For more information, please see our video

title: Legal writer
description:
U. S. Immigration Law Firm, Law offices of Jacob J Sapochnick is growing and developing law firm in the USA that specializes in business, employment, investment, and family immigration to the USA. The law firm is known for providing its best to the clients by offering creative and strategic legal solutions. We are looking for the new team member, legal writer, to join our team.
Responsibilities:
Legal Brief & Petition Drafting:
Preparing legal briefs, including personal statements, expert opinions, and supporting arguments.
Engaging in extensive drafting, developing persuasive and well-structured arguments tailored to each case. Case Strategy & Implementation:
Collaborating with senior legal specialists and U. S. attorneys to understand and execute case strategy effectively.
Ensuring that all legal arguments align with case objectives and meet the highest professional standards. Legal Research & Analysis:
Conducting in-depth legal research to identify relevant statutes, judicial decisions, and immigration regulations
Staying up to date with evolving immigration laws and policy changes to ensure compliance and accuracy.
Be creative in drafting – must have!!! Document Review
Reviewing client-provided documentation, identifying missing materials
Ensuring petitions are fully prepared in advance for mid and final attorney reviews, facilitating timely submission. Attorney Support & Quality Assurance:
Assisting attorneys in case preparation, including gathering supporting documents, drafting legal arguments, and compiling evidence.
Collaborating with team members to enhance the accuracy, clarity, and persuasiveness of all written materials. Requirements:
· Excellent grammar, spelling, and written English composition skills is a must.
· B. A. Degree in Law or Political Sciences or English studies student or graduate.
· Previous legal or immigration writing experience preferred.
· Extraordinary research and creative writing skills in English.
· High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and excellent proofreading skills.
· Strong organizational skills; ability to work under pressure, work within competing deadlines, and prioritize workload effectively.
· Strong technical aptitude, including the ability to quickly learn new applications.
Salary depending on experience from $ - $ . Schedule:
8-hour shift,
Monday to Friday
Remote work Submit your CV and writing sample (no Chat GPT) to email:

title: Associate ii, pharmacovigilance - brazil - remote
description:
What the Associate II, Pharmacovigilance does at Worldwide
Responsible for the collection, processing, evaluation and reporting of incoming Serious Adverse Event (SAE) data according to applicable regulatory guidelines/requirements, Worldwide Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and project specific instructions. Serves as Lead PV Associate on moderate to large sized studies that are moderate to complex in scope of work with moderate support from senior staff.
What you will do
Author Safety Management Plan for assigned studies
Attend and present at Investigator Meetings
Review incoming SAE data for completeness and accuracy
Perform data entry in the Safety Database and/or complete applicable tracking of incoming safety information
Perform QC of SAEs processed by other PV Associates
Generate regulatory reports and perform safety submissions as needed What you will bring to the role
Strong understanding of medical and scientific terminology, of the principles of clinical assessment of adverse drug events, of international regulations and of reporting requirements
Strong understanding of computer technology, and management of relational database systems, including extraction of data
Excellent organizational skills and ability to handle multiple competing priorities within tight timelines
Consistently demonstrates commitment, dependability, cooperation, adaptability and flexibility in executing daily tasks and responsibilities Your experience
Minimum of 3 years of pharmacovigilance experience (pre-approval clinical trials)
Bachelor's degree in science related field, nursing or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience
Computer literacy and strong working knowledge of MS Office applications (Excel, Power Point, Word)
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Excellent organization skills and attention to detail
Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities while adhering to applicable timelines
Ability to work independently, prioritize work effectively and work successfully in matrix team environment
Ability and willingness for potential limited travel (domestic and international) as needed (attend Investigator Meeting, project kick-off meeting and/or bid defense meeting)
Fluent in written and verbal English

title: Virtual assistant
description:
Virtual Assistant - Fully Remote
About the job:
We are looking for someone who will help our team with various tasks, has excellent written and spoken English skills, and is attentive to detail and organized.
You will be given various tasks to perform, but your major role is to help us with some marketing activities for our agency and our clients. You will be responsible for crafting and sending personalized outreach messages, reporting, creating Canva designs and working with videos, scheduling posts, scheduling meetings, downloading and cleaning databases, and more. Full training is provided.
This is a full-time role Mon-Fri for 40 hours per week with occasional overtime. Work time from 9:30am – 6.00pm New York Time (with a 30-minute break). You will be working with US clients, but you can live outside of the US; therefore, we would like to have someone in our team who knows American Culture and speaks decent English. Experience with appointment setting, understanding a fitness niche and/or having a sales/ business/ marketing background is an advantage. The company may offer growth opportunities depending on performance.
Requirements:
Strong English skills, a neutral accent, and familiarity with American culture.
Commitment to working 9:30am – 6.00pm New York Time.
Excellent communication and organizational skills.
Passion for digital marketing and a hunger to learn.
Experience in marketing or fitness is a bonus, but not required.
Attention to detail is a must (!!!>> When filling out the form, put your postcode as G9999, DO NOT put your real postcode
Enjoy long-term stability and 100% remote.
Join a supportive team.
Get top-notch training in marketing and beyond.
Starting at $600/month with performance bonuses as you grow.
Enjoy weekly payments for financial peace of mind.
12 paid vacation days per year as part of your total compensation package.
Growth Opportunities and Full Training.

title: Desenvolvedor backend sênior node
description:
Esperado para o cargo
Atuar como referência técnica fundamental dentro da squad, focando na execução de tarefas de alta complexidade com autonomia e qualidade. Espera-se que este profissional garanta a estabilidade e a performance das aplicações Back-end (Node.js), dissemine boas práticas de engenharia (como Clean Code e SOLID) através de Code Reviews rigorosos e atue como mentor técnico para desenvolvedores de níveis Júnior e Pleno, elevando a barra técnica do time sem perder o foco na entrega de valor para o negócio.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Projetar, desenvolver e manter microsserviços escaláveis utilizando Node.js, Type Script e arquitetura Serverless na AWS.
Realizar Code Reviews detalhados, garantindo a qualidade do código, segurança e a conformidade com os padrões arquiteturais definidos.
Escrever e manter testes automatizados (unitários e de integração) para garantir a confiabilidade das entregas.
Atuar na investigação e resolução de incidentes críticos em produção (troubleshooting), bem como na otimização de performance de rotinas e banco de dados (No SQL).
Apoiar tecnicamente a gestão de produto na viabilidade de novos requisitos e colaborar na estimativa de esforço das tarefas da squad. Requisitos e qualificações
Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento back-end utilizando Node.js e Type Script.
Domínio na construção de APIs RESTful e uso de frameworks como Nest JS ou Express.
Vivência prática com arquitetura de microsserviços e mensageria (AWS SQS/SNS ou similares).
Experiência com bancos de dados No SQL (Mongo DB), incluindo modelagem e otimização de performance.
Conhecimento sólido em serviços da AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, Dynamo DB, S3).
Prática habitual de escrita de testes automatizados (unitários e de integração).
Habilidade com Git, fluxos de Code Review e ambientes de CI/CD. Diferencial:
Experiência com Docker e orquestração (Kubernetes).
Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform ou Serverless Framework).
Familiaridade com ferramentas de observabilidade (Datadog, New Relic ou Cloud Watch).
Vivência com bancos de dados relacionais (Postgre SQL) ou caches (Redis).
Conhecimento em práticas de segurança de aplicação (OWASP). Modelo de Contratação:
Regime: PJ + Benefícios.
Localização: 100% Remoto

title: Forensic manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.
Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.
Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. title: Llm scientist
description:
We are looking for an \"LLM Scientist\" for our client, an international AI development company based in New York, who will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, enhancing the quality of data and the efficiency of data pipelines, and contribute to a team culture that values mentorship and knowledge sharing.
Key Responsibilities
Design and execute experiments by conducting ablation studies on various prompt strategies, tokenization methods, and fine-tuning hyperparameters.
Own model decisions regarding the selection of foundation models for specific tasks and the acceptable trade-offs between latency and accuracy.
Architect data pipelines in collaboration with Data Engineers to curate high-quality synthetic data and improve model training efficiency.
Solve complex 'hallucination' problems by serving as the final escalation point for enhancing model factuality and designing logic for retrievers and re-rankers.
Mentor the team by translating the latest research papers into actionable engineering tickets.
Qualification Required
Extensive experience with Py Torch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, Accelerate).
Proven track record of fine-tuning models, with a deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional embeddings, and transformer architectures.
Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and familiarity with the mathematics behind similarity search and embedding models.
Proficiency in Python, along with familiarity in containerization (Docker) and cloud-scale Al training (AWS Sage Maker/GCP Vertex Al).
Ability to analyze model failures, hypothesize root causes, and systematically test solutions.
Nice to Have
Advanced Degree: A Master's or Ph D in Computer Science, Math, or a related field with a focus on NLP.
Multi-Modal Experience: Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLM) or audio-to-text integration.
Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization).
Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public Git Hub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the Gen Al space.
Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization.
About Our Client
Our client is a people-focused organization dedicated to developing impactful products and services that create meaningful value for customers and communities. They foster a collaborative, respectful, and inclusive work environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow professionally. The company supports flexibility and work–life balance while maintaining strong performance and accountability standards.
Benefits & Wellbeing
Compensation for this role is determined based on competitive market data and may vary depending on geographic location, experience, skills, and qualifications. Specific details will be discussed during the interview process.
The company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' well-being, financial security, and professional development. Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plan contributions, paid time off, flexible working arrangements, and opportunities for career growth, in accordance with company policies and applicable local regulations. It is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country of employment.

Aqui na Arauc transformamos ideias em software, viabilizando o empreendedorismo com startups e digitalizando operações de empresas estabelecidas. Para continuarmos entregando produtos digitais de excelência, buscamos um Coordenador de Desenvolvimento de Software (REMOTO) apaixonado por tecnologia, com forte visão de produto e focado em resultados. Assegurar a qualidade do produto final através de revisão de código, rotinas de testes e validação rigorosa das entregas.

Forte conhecimento prático em Arquitetura de Software e Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Firebase).

Capacidade de transitar entre o planejamento e a execução técnica.

Vivência em ambientes dinâmicos de startups e metodologias ágeis.

title: Senior software engineering manager
description:
About the Job
As Silicon Valley Consulting we help companies improve their ads by building custom martech solutions.
You'll be working for Silicon Valley Consulting's child company TGA Fund. (
TGA Fund is a high-ownership venture builder studio that invests in startups and creates new startups in-house.
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineering Manager to join our team! This is not a generic engineering management role. We need an engineer, first who is a hands on platform leader, reliable and decisive, with great communication skills.
This is a high-ownership role where you'll lead critical platform initiatives, scale high-performing teams, and shape the technical foundations of upcoming projects/products.
You'll get to manage multiple Saa S products via the engineering team that you'll lead. You also get revenue share from the products you'll manage via the engineering team.
You Will:
Be in charge of the given quarterly budget, dictating how many engineering contractors that you can/want to have on the team.
Interview engineering candidates.
Code during crunch times. What You'll Bring:
(Preferred qualifications)
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Proficiency with backend service technologies (e. g. , Java, Go, Javascript), RESTful API development, and modern engineering best practices.
Experience with data systems (SQL/No SQL), messaging technologies (e. g. , Kafka), containerized environments (e. g. , Kubernetes) and UI technologies.
Familiarity with AI/ML ecosystems, including large language models, agentic AI, or AI productivity tools.
Typically 4+ years of engineering experience with at least 1 years leading multiple teams and senior level engineering talent
Solid understanding of system design, architecture principles, UI frameworks, and API driven ecosystems.
Experience building or contributing to largescale marketplace or platform products.
Strong problem solving abilities and familiarity with SDLC, CI/CD, observability, and production operations.
Ability to partner across teamsand operate effectively in dynamic or ambiguous situations.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Commitment to fostering a healthy, inclusive team culture focused on quality, accountability, and continuous learning. If we like you, you'll be given a 90-day trial period.
Please do not forget that this is a part-time role.
Base pay during trial period: $280 USD to $500 USD per month (part-time)
Benefits:
Bonuses come from Revenue Sharing + Profit Sharing
We also give you the opportunity to bring in your own ideas. If you have a project you want to realize, and believe it can benefit from our support, then you can always ask for a vote. If your idea passes the vote, we will partner with your dream and scale it with you.
Why Us?
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally.
SVC and TGA Fund invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our organizations. We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: Account manager
description:
LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world's biggest problems?

Oneday is a VC-backed Ed Tech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.
We have raised $20 M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.

Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)

Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment

Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
Fully remote working environment
Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

title: Virtual executive assistant – family owned business group
description:
Summary
We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production.
Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts. We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.
This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries, gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.
Responsibilities
Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
Serve as a primary communication liaison, screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
Prepare meeting materials, agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers, including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
Assist with special projects, including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance Qualifications
2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
Highly resourceful and high-agency, with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets), Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
Availability to work during overlapping U. S. Eastern Time hours Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier What We Offer
Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
Exposure to a diversified business portfolio, not a single company role
Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

A Tipspace é uma startup de games em rápido crescimento, focada em oferecer uma experiência inovadora para jogadores que desejam monetizar suas habilidades e competir em partidas valendo prêmios em dinheiro. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é leve e descontraído, com uma cultura gamer forte – todos do time são apaixonados por jogos. Ao mesmo tempo, somos muito dedicados: trabalhamos duro para fazer a empresa dar certo e entregar a melhor experiência possível aos nossos usuários.

Bancos de Dados relacionais

SQL para consultas estruturadas
Python, com ênfase em manipulação de dados e treinamento de modelos de Machine Learning
Git para controle de versões em bases compartilhadas de código Responsabilidades

description:
About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements:
Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Líder técnico
description:
Estamos contratando: Tech Lead (foco Frontend)
Se você é o tipo de profissional que não só escreve código — mas eleva o time inteiro a um novo nível — essa vaga é pra você.
Sobre a vaga
Somos uma empresa Saa S em crescimento, com produtos digitais rodando em produção. Temos um time de frontend que precisa de direção técnica real: alguém que faça code review com profundidade, defina padrões, garanta qualidade e ainda contribua com código quando necessário.
O foco principal é no frontend — React, Next.js, performance, arquitetura de componentes, boas práticas. PHP existe na stack, mas a prioridade aqui é quem domina o mundo JS/TS moderno.
O que você vai fazer
→ Liderar tecnicamente o time (2 devs frontend plenos + 1 backend pleno + 1 sênior backend)
→ Conduzir code reviews de React e Next.js com critério e profundidade
→ Definir padrões de arquitetura, componentização e qualidade frontend
→ Estruturar o processo de desenvolvimento do zero
→ Identificar gargalos e remover bloqueios do time
→ Dar feedback claro e direto quando necessário
O que esperamos
→ Experiência sólida com React e Next.js (obrigatório)
→ Capacidade de liderar e fazer code review com autoridade técnica no frontend
→ Perfil hands-on: lidera e ainda contribui com código
→ Experiência com Type Script, boas práticas de performance e acessibilidade
→ Familiaridade com PHP é um diferencial, não um requisito
→ Experiência em estruturar processos em times sem metodologia definida
→ Comunicação clara e maturidade pra dar feedbacks difíceis
Remuneração: A combinar
100% Remoto
---
ATENÇÃO — Como se candidatar
Não aceitamos candidaturas por aqui.
As inscrições são feitas exclusivamente pelo nosso processo seletivo online, onde você responde perguntas técnicas e comportamentais e já recebe na hora um parecer sobre sua compatibilidade com a vaga.
Candidate-se agora:
Leva cerca de 15 minutos. Você sabe na hora se avança.

title: Legal assistant
description:
Position OverviewGemean is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Legal Assistant to support our legal, forensic, and investigative teams. In this role, you will assist with case preparation, document management, and coordination across legal and investigative matters. You will work closely with attorneys, analysts, and project managers to ensure efficient case handling, accurate documentation, and timely communication. This position plays an important role in maintaining operational efficiency and supporting complex litigation, investigations, and regulatory matters.
Key Responsibilities
Assist legal teams with preparation and organization of case files, documentation, and supporting materials
Manage legal documents, correspondence, and records while maintaining accurate filing systems
Support document review processes and assist with organizing electronically stored information (ESI) for investigations and litigation
Coordinate with internal teams including e Discovery, forensic analysts, and project managers on case-related tasks
Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, and maintain calendars for legal professionals
Assist in drafting routine legal correspondence, reports, and administrative documentation
Track case progress, deadlines, and important milestones to ensure timely execution
Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive legal information with discretion Required Qualifications and Skills
Proven experience as a legal assistant, paralegal support professional, or in a similar legal administrative role
Bachelor's degree in Law, Legal Studies, Business Administration, or a related field
Experience supporting legal, compliance, forensic investigation, financial, or Web3-related matters involving case documentation and administrative coordination
Strong organizational and document management skills with high attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Proficiency in common office and document management software tools
Ability to handle sensitive legal, financial, and investigative information with discretion Additional Preferred Qualifications and Skills
Experience supporting litigation, investigations, or compliance matters preferred
Familiarity with e Discovery processes and legal documentation workflows is advantageous
Knowledge of legal research methods and document review practices is beneficial
Exposure to forensic investigations or regulatory environments is a plus About Gemean
Gemean is a global leader in forensic investigations, electronic discovery, and data analytics. We utilize advanced platforms like Pyth AI and cutting-edge data tools to interpret complex datasets, support legal cases, and fortify organizational compliance and governance. Our multidisciplinary approach enables us to deliver comprehensive, actionable insights tailored to our clients' needs.

description:

you to apply!

title: Product owner
description:
Product Owner – Client Onboarding & Customer Success
Remote (Brazil-based) | Supporting UK & US stakeholders | 8,000 - 10,000 BRL
We're proud to be partnering with an innovative, fast-growing Saa S business that is transforming how organisations deliver professional online auction experiences under their own brand. Following a period of impressive growth, our client is now looking to appoint a Product Owner – Client Onboarding & Customer Success to play a pivotal role in their next phase.
This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of product, clients, and operations—owning the journey from signed deal through to successful platform adoption.
The Opportunity
As Product Owner, you'll take the lead in ensuring new clients are seamlessly onboarded and set up for success from day one. Working closely with senior leadership, engineering, and customer success, you'll help clients quickly reach their first live auction and build long-term confidence using the platform.
This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role where you'll:
Guide clients through onboarding and implementation
Translate real-world client needs into clear product requirements
Support ongoing customer success and operational excellence
Play a key role in product testing and continuous improvement What You'll Be Doing
Owning the end-to-end onboarding journey from sales handover to go-live
Acting as a trusted partner to clients, supporting early use and best practice
Gathering and defining technical and operational requirements
Collaborating with engineering to ensure smooth configuration and delivery
Testing new features and ensuring releases are client-ready
Feeding real client insight back into the product roadmap What We're Looking For
Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Saa S Implementation specialist
A strong track record in customer success, onboarding, or client-facing roles
Ability to translate client needs into structured product requirements
Comfortable working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams
Highly organised, proactive, and confident managing multiple stakeholders
Exposure to B2 B Saa S, Agile environments, or platform-based products would be highly advantageous. Why Apply?
Join a scaling, globally-focused Saa S business at an exciting stage of growth
Work directly with an experienced and passionate leadership team
Have real influence over product direction and client success
Fully remote role with international collaboration
Be instrumental in shaping how clients experience and succeed with the platform If you're a product-minded professional who thrives on solving real client problems and driving meaningful outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Consulting partner
description:

This is not a traditional consultancy role; it's a chance to run your own practice within a global brand, with the freedom to shape your market, build your team, and grow your client base while backed by ERA's proven methodologies, tools, and worldwide community.

Lead cost optimisation, procurement, and performance improvement programmes across industries

Take ownership of your practice's strategic direction, go-to-market approach, and team leadership
Work directly with C-level clients to deliver measurable savings and transformation What You Bring
Extensive consulting or senior leadership experience in cost management, procurement, or performance improvement
A strong track record of client acquisition and project delivery
Deep expertise in one or more industries such as Pharma/Life Sciences, Energy/Utilities, Manufacturing, Consumer, or Logistics
Confidence in engaging with Cx O-level stakeholders and leveraging your professional network
An entrepreneurial mindset with the ambition to grow a successful consulting practice This is the ideal next step if you're seeking less bureaucracy, more independence, and the chance to build something of your own within a global consultancy platform.
By applying, you agree to the use of your personal data for recruitment and related communications, in accordance with the UK GDPR.

title: Sap basis upgrades sum and conversion specialist
description:
We are seeking skilled SAP Basis Experts to execute complex SAP system upgrades and conversions, The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise in SAP Basis, a strong understanding of SAP architecture, and hands-on experience with SAP system conversions, upgrades, copies and migrations.
Key Responsibilities:7+ years of Basis Experience
Plan and execute SAP system upgrades (Net Weaver, EHP, SPS, Kernel) across development, quality, and production environments.
Lead SAP S/4 HANA system conversions from ECC, including pre-checks, simplification item analysis, and custom code remediation.
Utilize tools such as SUM (Software Update Manager), Maintenance Planner, DMO (Database Migration Option), and SPAM/SAINT.
Experience in Update, System copies and Client copies
Perform OS/DB migrations, Unicode conversions, and HANA database upgrades.
Conduct mock conversions, dry runs, and cutover planning for production migrations.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure compatibility and readiness for upgrades and conversions.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues during and post-upgrade/conversion.
Maintain comprehensive documentation of upgrade/conversion procedures and lessons learned.
Stay current with SAP's roadmap, release strategy, and best practices for upgrades and conversions.
ECS experience is added advantage

Startup em constante evolução: Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de aprender e crescer!

Experiência prévia em gestão de atendimento ou Customer Success no modelo B2 B.

Perfil comunicativo, analítico e com forte foco em resolução de problemas. Diferencial: Liderança em e-commerce
O que oferecemos:
Modelo de trabalho 100% remoto.
Bônus mensal por resultados.
Ambiente dinâmico, inovador e colaborativo.

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world's largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.
Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world's largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.
How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain's GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends Education & Work Experience

Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.) Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment Equal Opportunity Employer

We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

description:

English Resume Only
Location: Brazil
Type: Full-Time Contract
Setup: Fully Remote
Level: Mid-Level
Industry: Software SAAS Company
Shift: US Hours
Start Date: can start in 2 weeks after offer
Equipment: Available upon request
Rate: R$8,000 - R$10,000
About The Methodical Group
The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.
About the Opportunity
Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.
The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.
Responsibilities
Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations. Qualifications
At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

We are seeking an AI & Innovation Experience Designer to help define the next generation of intelligent commerce experiences. This role will focus on conceptualizing and designing new AI-powered capabilities and hyper-personalized shopping journeys for a large-scale digital marketplace platform.
You will own the AI Tools and Hyper-Personalization workstreams, exploring how generative AI, advanced data models, and intelligent systems can transform how customers discover products, interact with sellers, and navigate digital retail environments.
This role requires a designer who is comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoys shaping 0-to-1 product concepts. You will translate emerging technologies into compelling user experiences through prototypes, concept designs, and future-state product visions.

title: Dental insurance posting agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.
As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you'll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You'll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.
About i Core
i Core is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.
We are more than a software company. i Core Connect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.
Behind i Core Connect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We're proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.
Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.
Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.
Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.
Objectives:
Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns Competencies:
Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
Full English proficiency
Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
Ability to pass job-specific assessments Benefits:
Personal:
Be a valued leader, not just a trainer You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.
Make a real difference at scale Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices, and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.
Work with a mission-driven team You'll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.
100% remote – work from home Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.
Better work-life balance While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.
Stability and long-term growth Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.
Professional:
Grow your training and leadership skills Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.
