title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.
Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co's data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.
Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.

Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule

title: Líder técnico
description:
Estamos contratando: Tech Lead (foco Frontend)
Se você é o tipo de profissional que não só escreve código — mas eleva o time inteiro a um novo nível — essa vaga é pra você.
Sobre a vaga
Somos uma empresa Saa S em crescimento, com produtos digitais rodando em produção. Temos um time de frontend que precisa de direção técnica real: alguém que faça code review com profundidade, defina padrões, garanta qualidade e ainda contribua com código quando necessário.
O foco principal é no frontend — React, Next.js, performance, arquitetura de componentes, boas práticas. PHP existe na stack, mas a prioridade aqui é quem domina o mundo JS/TS moderno.
O que você vai fazer
→ Liderar tecnicamente o time (2 devs frontend plenos + 1 backend pleno + 1 sênior backend)
→ Conduzir code reviews de React e Next.js com critério e profundidade
→ Definir padrões de arquitetura, componentização e qualidade frontend
→ Estruturar o processo de desenvolvimento do zero
→ Identificar gargalos e remover bloqueios do time
→ Dar feedback claro e direto quando necessário
O que esperamos
→ Experiência sólida com React e Next.js (obrigatório)
→ Capacidade de liderar e fazer code review com autoridade técnica no frontend
→ Perfil hands-on: lidera e ainda contribui com código
→ Experiência com Type Script, boas práticas de performance e acessibilidade
→ Familiaridade com PHP é um diferencial, não um requisito
→ Experiência em estruturar processos em times sem metodologia definida
→ Comunicação clara e maturidade pra dar feedbacks difíceis
Remuneração: A combinar
100% Remoto

Não aceitamos candidaturas por aqui.
As inscrições são feitas exclusivamente pelo nosso processo seletivo online, onde você responde perguntas técnicas e comportamentais e já recebe na hora um parecer sobre sua compatibilidade com a vaga.
Candidate-se agora:
Leva cerca de 15 minutos. Você sabe na hora se avança.

description:

Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.
Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.
Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é a sua chance. Nessa posição de Data Science Specialist I, você vai somar ao time Data Science que tem como objetivo construir soluções de dados para evoluir experiência do usuário e métricas de negócio de forma escalável.
No dia a dia você vai:
Construir e manter pipelines completos de treinamento, versionamento, testes e deploy de modelos de ML
Implementar práticas de MLOps para automação, monitoramento e manutenção de modelos em produção
Gerenciar ambientes, contêineres, GPUs, escalabilidade e orquestração de recursos
Atuar em parceria com Cientistas de IA para transformar experimentos em soluções produtivas
Garantir observabilidade dos modelos, monitorando drift, performance, custo, logs e métricas
Criar infraestrutura de experimentação e padronizar fluxos de desenvolvimento de IA
Suportar segurança, governança e boas práticas na gestão do ciclo de vida dos modelos E o que você precisa ter?
Experiência com pipelines de ML/MLOps, CI/CD (Github Actions) e ferramentas como Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow, AWS Sagemaker
Conhecimento em containers (Docker), Kubernetes, APIs e Python
Vivência em ambientes Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure)
Forte entendimento de modelos de Machine Learning Diferenciais:
Experiência com modelagem e manipulação de dados em larga escala
Experiência com processamento e deploy de modelos em tempo real/NRT Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:
No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:

Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world's largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.
Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world's largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.

Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain's GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements

Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends Education & Work Experience

Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.) Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Ai & innovation experience designer
description:
AI & Innovation Experience Designer
About the Role
We are seeking an AI & Innovation Experience Designer to help define the next generation of intelligent commerce experiences. This role will focus on conceptualizing and designing new AI-powered capabilities and hyper-personalized shopping journeys for a large-scale digital marketplace platform.
You will own the AI Tools and Hyper-Personalization workstreams, exploring how generative AI, advanced data models, and intelligent systems can transform how customers discover products, interact with sellers, and navigate digital retail environments.
This role requires a designer who is comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoys shaping 0-to-1 product concepts. You will translate emerging technologies into compelling user experiences through prototypes, concept designs, and future-state product visions.
What You'll Do
Conceptualize new AI-powered commerce experiences across search, discovery, and personalized shopping journeys.
Design innovative features powered by generative AI and machine learning, such as contextual search, personalized product detail pages, AI-generated retail media, and intelligent seller tools.
Explore how data and personalization models can create dynamic, hyper-personalized user experiences throughout the shopping lifecycle.
Develop concept prototypes and design explorations that communicate future product possibilities and inspire product leadership.
Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and data teams to translate AI capabilities into meaningful user experiences.
Present forward-looking concepts and design narratives to stakeholders, helping shape the long-term product vision.
Operate within a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles and evolving requirements. Required Qualifications
5+ years of experience in product design or UX design, with exposure to emerging technologies or innovation-focused work
Experience designing AI-powered or data-driven product experiences
Strong conceptual thinking and ability to design future-state product concepts
Ability to communicate complex ideas through prototypes, visual concepts, and design storytelling
Understanding of personalization systems, recommendation engines, or conversational AI patterns
Comfort working in ambiguous, early-stage product environments
Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
Ability to work effectively in fast-paced consulting environments Preferred Qualifications
Experience designing Gen AI-powered features, including conversational interfaces, AI search, content generation, or recommendation systems
Familiarity with retail media platforms, seller tools, or marketplace ecosystems
Experience designing for conversational commerce platforms such as messaging-based shopping experiences
Exposure to or interest in the Brazilian or Latin American technology ecosystem This role is ideal for a designer who enjoys exploring the intersection of AI, commerce, and product innovation. If you're excited about shaping intelligent, personalized digital experiences and pushing the boundaries of what modern e-commerce can become, we'd love to connect.

title: Dental insurance posting agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.
As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you'll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You'll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.
About i Core
i Core is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.
We are more than a software company. i Core Connect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.
Behind i Core Connect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We're proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.
Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.
Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.
Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.
Objectives:
Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns Competencies:
Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
Full English proficiency
Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
Ability to pass job-specific assessments Benefits:
Personal:
Be a valued leader, not just a trainer You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.
Make a real difference at scale Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices, and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.
Work with a mission-driven team You'll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.
100% remote – work from home Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.
Better work-life balance While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.
Stability and long-term growth Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.
Professional:
Grow your training and leadership skills Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.
Work with industry leaders in dental Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.
Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.
Build and lead teams Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.
Expand your industry network Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.
Develop enterprise-level experience Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.
What you can expect from a career with our team!
Competitive hourly rate
Schedule: 8 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST

Work Setup: Fully remote position You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals.
If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!

description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

You be your own boss and set your own schedule

Portuguese as a first language.

title: Full-stack developer
description:
Join one of the most exciting early-stage platforms as we scale our engineering team globally.
You'll be building on your full-stack experience, evolving a platform that balances cutting-edge tech with real-world stability. We are looking for a pragmatic \"builder\" who is comfortable in a fast-moving, early-stage environment and can take a feature from a raw idea to a polished delivery.
This is a 100% remote contract role (PJ) for a developer based in Brazil, reporting to our US/UK-based leadership. You'll be central to our product delivery, working across the entire stack to ensure our users have a seamless, reliable experience.
Some of your day-to-day will be:
Full-Stack Development: Owning features from end-to-end using Type Script and React.
Backend & Data: Building and maintaining robust services with Postgres and integrating third-party APIs.
Product Evolution: Supporting ongoing feature delivery and improving stability across key user flows.
Code Quality: Contributing to a maintainable codebase as the platform grows, balancing speed with long-term reliability.
Smart Engineering: Utilizing modern tools and AI-assisted workflows to accelerate delivery without losing sight of fundamental coding principles. Requirements:
Mid-to-Senior Experience: Strong background in Java Script/Type Script and modern frontend frameworks (React).
Database Fluency: Proven experience with relational databases (Postgres or similar).
Startup Mindset: Someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment where requirements evolve.
Independent Operator: Able to take ownership of tasks and work autonomously to hit delivery goals.
Communicator: Professional English proficiency (written and spoken) to collaborate with our international team.
Pragmatic: A focus on \"what works\" and \"what scales,\" avoiding over-engineering where it isn't needed. Benefits:
International Contract (PJ): Competitive remuneration.
100% Remote: Work from anywhere in Brazil.
Direct Impact: Work directly with the founding team; no layers of middle management.
Modern Stack: Access to the latest development tools and a clean, high-velocity environment.
Growth: Opportunity to grow alongside the platform as we scale.

description:
Boost your career in the railway sector with ALTEN Spain
Take part in innovative railway projects in Barcelona (Spain), bringing your experience in system development, validation, and testing for rolling stock.
At ALTEN, we believe that people are the true driving force behind our projects. That's why, if you have at least 3 years of experience in railway system projects—whether in Validation, Verification, Testing, or Development—we want to support your professional growth, enhance your talent, and provide an environment where you feel valued from day one.
Would you like to be part of the future of mobility? Keep reading
Your mission
Based in Spain, you will contribute to key projects by ensuring the proper validation and performance of railway systems, helping guarantee the highest standards of quality and safety.
Key responsibilities
Define, plan, and execute tests for railway systems in rolling stock
Ensure quality, safety, and compliance in validation and testing processes
Collaborate with engineering teams, external laboratories, and end clients
Manage timelines and ensure safety during testing phases
Monitor progress, results, and budget of validation and verification activities What we are looking for
Degree in Engineering (Bachelor's or Master's)
At least 3 years of experience in validation, verification, or testing of railway systems
Experience in rolling stock projects is highly valued
Advanced level of English (B2 or higher)
Teamwork skills, results-oriented mindset, and proactive attitude
Interest in relocating to Barcelona, Spain What we offer
Relocation to Spain: ALTEN will take care of all legal procedures
Join a solid, fast-growing multinational company with a strong presence in Spain
Be part of a highly qualified team in a collaborative, dynamic, and innovative environment
Access to specialized training and continuous professional development
Competitive salary based on your experience
Social benefits and a flexible compensation plan
Who we are
At ALTEN, we are more than a consultancy—we are a team driven by engineering, innovation, and talent.
We are part of a leading European multinational specializing in engineering and technology consulting, working with top-tier companies across the market.
In Spain, we have over 5,240 professionals, 9 offices, and generate more than €217 million in revenue.
At ALTEN, we are committed to diversity and equal opportunities, regardless of gender, age, abilities, or background. We believe in talent—and in the people who make it happen.
If you're ready to take the next step in your career in Spain, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Data analyst
description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Our client is a rapidly growing Microsoft 365 and Workplace Management consultancy with offices in the UK, Asia and LATAM. They are 100% committed to fostering the growth and development of all our team members. They offer a range of professional development opportunities to support both permanent staff and contractors in advancing their skills and careers. Through training programs, mentorship, and access to industry resources, they ensure that everyone has the tools and support needed to succeed and grow within the organisation.
They are looking for someone who is versatile, with great analysis and documentation skills to work with our project teams to develop data solutions and carry out analysis for our customers. Excellent English-speaking skills and a flexible attitude are a must!
Candidates MUST be located and living in Brazil. Applications from other countries will be immediately rejected.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Analyse, clean and organize raw data from multiple sources
Model and display data with storytelling back to the business and to the programme team
Explain and present technical information to non-experts and support and coach users on technologies
Produce and maintain dashboard reports on project and data migration activity
Troubleshoot Excel related issues such as macros and linked files
Carry out ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes for related data migration projects
Create and maintain adhoc and operational reports
Troubleshoot data migration issues as and when required EXPERIENCE
Minimum 2 years working as a Data Analyst
2 years experience creating and deploying custom Power BI dashboards
Experience working on IT infrastructure projects (desirable)
Experience working with Microsoft 365 data (desirable)
Experience working in data migration projects and ETL processes
Experience developing and maintaining Management Information (MI) reports QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS
Business/B2+ Level English
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
High level of numeracy and attention to detail
Advanced Excel skills (advanced formulas, pivot tables, macros/VBA)
Strong Power BI (Power Query, M, DAX)
Microsoft Fabric
Strong analytical and documentation skills
Python Scripting skills (Pandas, Num Py, Seaborn, Matplotlib)
Power Shell scripting (desirable)
SQL skills (desirable)
Developer skills (desirable)
Microsoft Dataverse (desirable)
Microsoft Intelligent Data Platform (desirable)
Good Power Point and presentation skills
Experience working with IT systems and related projects (desirable)
Motivated self-starter
Personable and professional manner Our client actively encourages applications from individuals with disabilities and try to provide access, adjustments, equipment, or other practical support where required. They welcome applications from people with backgrounds that are traditionally underrepresented in tech and truly believe diversity is the key to creativity and innovation.

title: Staff machine learning engineer | data science
description:
Descrição da vaga
Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.
Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.
Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é a sua chance. Nessa posição de Data Science Specialist I, você vai somar ao time Data Science que tem como objetivo construir soluções de dados para evoluir experiência do usuário e métricas de negócio de forma escalável.
No dia a dia você vai:
Construir e manter pipelines completos de treinamento, versionamento, testes e deploy de modelos de ML
Implementar práticas de MLOps para automação, monitoramento e manutenção de modelos em produção
Gerenciar ambientes, contêineres, GPUs, escalabilidade e orquestração de recursos
Atuar em parceria com Cientistas de IA para transformar experimentos em soluções produtivas
Garantir observabilidade dos modelos, monitorando drift, performance, custo, logs e métricas
Criar infraestrutura de experimentação e padronizar fluxos de desenvolvimento de IA
Suportar segurança, governança e boas práticas na gestão do ciclo de vida dos modelos E o que você precisa ter?
Experiência com pipelines de ML/MLOps, CI/CD (Github Actions) e ferramentas como Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow, AWS Sagemaker
Conhecimento em containers (Docker), Kubernetes, APIs e Python
Vivência em ambientes Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure)
Forte entendimento de modelos de Machine Learning Diferenciais:
Experiência com modelagem e manipulação de dados em larga escala
Experiência com processamento e deploy de modelos em tempo real/NRT Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:
No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.
Benefícios:
Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
Plano de Saúde;
Plano Odontológico;
Previdência Privada;
Benefícios flexíveis que se adaptam às suas necessidades;
Auxílio alimentação;
Aconselhamento financeiro;
Clube de vantagens;
Auxílio Home Office;
Auxílio Mobilidade;
Auxílio Criança;
Seguro de Vida;
Licenças estendidas;
Incentivo ao esporte, qualidade de vida e bem estar;
Empréstimo consignado com taxas reduzidas.

title: Senior analytics engineer
description:
Company Description
United Hub Digital (UHD) is a nearshore IT consulting firm helping mid and large US enterprise clients accelerate their data and technology initiatives. Headquartered in Greenville, SC, with a delivery hub in Brazil, we embed directly into client teams as a trusted execution partner across data analytics, software development, UI/UX, and project management. We hold ourselves to the same standards of accountability and delivery quality our clients expect from their own teams.
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help one of our enterprise clients unlock the value of their data for AI-driven use cases. The goal focus for this role is to 'make the data AI-ready': well-structured, semantically rich, documented, and governed.
Your primary output is a clean, well-documented, and semantically meaningful data environment that downstream AI workloads can reason over reliably.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What You Will Do
Semantic Modeling
Design and build semantic layers that translate raw ERP tables into business-meaningful domains (finance, procurement, supply chain, etc.)
Define and enforce naming conventions, metric definitions, and business logic in a shared, governed layer
Work with Databricks semantic layer to expose curated datasets for AI and analytics consumption Data Documentation and Context
Produce column-level documentation, data dictionaries, and business glossaries inside Unity Catalog
Establish lineage tracing from source system tables through to consumption-ready datasets
Collaborate with source systems stakeholders to capture domain knowledge and translate it into structured metadata AI Readiness
Structure data to support LLM-based and ML workloads, including RAG pipelines and structured querying
Identify and address data quality gaps that would undermine AI model reliability
Define thematic data domains and organize datasets to give AI systems the right context and scope Governance and Quality
Implement data quality rules and freshness monitors using Databricks tooling
Tag sensitive fields and support data access tier definitions within Unity Catalog
Own documentation standards and ensure the catalog remains accurate as data evolves ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Qualifications
Required
5+ years in analytics engineering, data architecture, or a closely related discipline
Hands-on Databricks expertise: Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, cluster configuration, and query optimization
Experience with semantic modeling tools, ideally dbt (dbt Core or dbt Cloud)
Strong SQL and a solid understanding of data modeling patterns (star schema, medallion architecture, etc.)
Ability to read and interpret unfamiliar data models quickly, including ERP-sourced data structures
Experience writing technical documentation that non-technical stakeholders can act on Nice to Have
Exposure to Databricks AI/BI, Genie, or Vector Search
Experience supporting ML or LLM-based downstream use cases
Background in data mesh or domain-oriented data architecture

You will help ICH navigate the complex landscape of blockchain technology, ensuring that our exposure to digital assets is compliant, secure, and aligned with long-term corporate goals.
Key Responsibilities
Fundamental Research & Due Diligence: Conduct deep-dive analysis of Web3 sectors (De Fi, Infrastructure, RWA, Layer 2s, Gaming). Evaluate projects based on technology, team credibility, tokenomics, and market fit.
Investment Thesis Development: Create and maintain actionable investment theses for the CIO and Board. Identify undervalued opportunities and potential risks in the crypto market.
On-Chain Analytics: Utilize tools like Dune Analytics, Nansen, Etherscan, and Defi Llama to verify project metrics, track user growth, monitor whale activity, and assess network health.
Tokenomics Modeling: Analyze token distribution models, vesting schedules, inflation rates, and utility mechanisms to identify sustainable projects vs. speculative pumps.
Executive Reporting: Prepare concise, high-impact investment memorandums and weekly market intelligence briefings for senior leadership.
Regulatory & Risk Monitoring: Stay updated on global regulatory developments (including Brazil's CVM guidelines, Mi CA in EU, and VARA in UAE) and assess their impact on ICH's strategy.
Portfolio Support: Monitor existing digital asset holdings or pilot projects, providing regular performance reports and rebalancing recommendations. Qualifications
Experience: 5+ years of experience in financial research, equity analysis, or venture capital, with at least 2–3 years specifically focused on Crypto/Web3 assets.
Technical Depth: Strong understanding of blockchain fundamentals (consensus mechanisms, smart contracts, De Fi primitives, ZK-proofs). Ability to read technical whitepapers and audit reports.
Analytical Skills: Proficiency in financial modeling (Excel/Google Sheets) and on-chain data analysis tools (Dune, Nansen, Arkham, Glassnode). SQL or Python skills are a strong plus.
Market Knowledge: Deep familiarity with the global crypto landscape, including key players, narratives (e.g., RWA, AI x Crypto), and market cycles.
Communication: Exceptional written English for reporting to international executives. Portuguese is native/preferred for local coordination.
Integrity: High ethical standards and attention to detail. You are skeptical by nature and rely on data, not hype. Compensation & Benefits
Competitive Salary: $105,000 - $150,000 USD per year (adjusted for experience and location).
Performance Bonus: Annual bonus tied to the accuracy of research insights and successful identification of opportunities.
Flexible Payment: Option to receive a portion of compensation in Stablecoins (USDC/USDT) or Fiat (BRL/USD), compliant with local laws.
Professional Growth: Budget for premium research tools (Messari, Token Terminal) and industry conferences.

title: Executivo de vendas
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com perfil técnico-comercial para atuar como Executivo de Vendas em um segmento industrial altamente especializado, focado em soluções de detecção e separação de metais em processos produtivos.
Se você gosta de desafios, tem perfil consultivo e quer atuar diretamente no campo, contribuindo com soluções técnicas que geram impacto real nos clientes, essa oportunidade é para você.
Sobre a posição
Você será responsável por conduzir todo o processo comercial, desde a prospecção até o fechamento, com forte atuação em campo. Além disso, terá papel fundamental na demonstração prática de equipamentos, suporte técnico e desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas para clientes industriais.
Principais responsabilidades:
Realizar prospecção ativa e visitas a clientes em diferentes regiões;
Conduzir apresentações técnicas e demonstrações de equipamentos em campo;
Levantar necessidades e desenvolver propostas comerciais alinhadas ao cliente;
Gerenciar o ciclo completo de vendas (prospecção, negociação e fechamento);
Expandir e desenvolver a carteira de clientes;
Acompanhar tendências de mercado e atuação da concorrência;
Elaborar relatórios comerciais e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho;
Atuar de forma integrada com áreas internas e parceiros comerciais;
Apoiar testes, treinamentos e implementação de soluções junto aos clientes. O que buscamos:
Formação superior em Engenharia (Controle e Automação, Elétrica, Mecânica, Produção) ou cursos técnicos correlatos (Mecatrônica, Elétrica, Automação);
Experiência em vendas externas no segmento industrial;
Vivência com automação, instrumentação ou processos produtivos será um diferencial;
Conhecimento em ambientes industriais e linhas produtivas;
Inglês intermediário ou avançado;
Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes. Perfil desejado:
Proatividade e autonomia;
Forte orientação para resultados;
Perfil consultivo e boa comunicação;
Organização e disciplina na gestão de atividades comerciais;
Capacidade analítica para entender problemas e propor soluções;
Postura colaborativa e senso de responsabilidade. Modelo de trabalho
Atuação majoritariamente em campo, com base em home office e disponibilidade para viagens.

title: Virtual executive assistant – family owned business group
description:
Summary
We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production.
Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts. We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.
This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries, gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.
Responsibilities
Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
Serve as a primary communication liaison, screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
Prepare meeting materials, agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers, including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
Assist with special projects, including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance Qualifications
2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
Highly resourceful and high-agency, with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets), Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
Availability to work during overlapping U. S. Eastern Time hours Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier What We Offer
Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
Exposure to a diversified business portfolio, not a single company role
Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Brazil packaging salesperson, remote
description:
We are a leading cosmetic packaging company. Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.
Role Description
We are seeking an experienced Brazilian Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have proven experience selling cosmetic and personal care packaging products into Brazilian markets, with a strong understanding of Brazilian business practices, regulations, and cultural nuances.
Compensation: $65,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience.
Responsibilities
The successful candidate will be responsible for:
- Developing and maintaining relationships with Brazilian cosmetic and personal care brands
- Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within Brazil's cosmetic packaging market
- Presenting cosmetic packaging solutions tailored to brand, regulatory, and consumer requirements
- Managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and reporting
- Collaborating with product development, compliance, and logistics teams to ensure customer satisfaction
- Meeting and exceeding sales targets
- Staying informed on market trends, regulations, and competitor activity in Brazilian cosmetic packaging markets
Qualifications
- Proven track record of successful B2 B sales in cosmetic packaging or closely related packaging industries
- Extensive experience working with Brazilian cosmetic, beauty, or personal care markets and customers
- Strong knowledge of Brazilian cosmetic packaging regulations, standards, and labeling requirements
- Fluent in English and Portuguese
- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
- Ability to travel to Brazil as needed (20-30% of the time)
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, or a related field
- Proficiency with CRM systems and sales tools
- Salesforce experience is a plus

title: Ux & data-driven usability designer
description:
UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer
About the Role
We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.
You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.
This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.
What You'll Do
Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment.
Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process.
Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns.
Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains.
Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles. Required Qualifications
5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
Strong problem-solving and research skills
Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines Preferred Qualifications
Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products
Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations
Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testing This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Data entry specialist
description:
WE ARE LOOKING FOR
Auditors of Certificates of Insurance
HOW THIS POSITION HELPS JONES SUCCEED
As an Auditor of Certificates of Insurance (COI) you will be responsible for verifying that the documents provided by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors in our platform have the necessary coverage required by our customers.
All the necessary training to perform the necessary tasks will be offered.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
The high-level goal for this role is to help the company to deliver accurate audit resolutions in a timely manner.
This role demands a high level of commitment and dedication; this is a full-time, hands-on position requiring 40 hours per week, with occasional after-hours work as needed (including additional compensation).
This is not a role for someone seeking a casual or part-time opportunity; it demands undivided attention and cannot be reconciled with concurrent employment commitments Be prepared for a fast-paced environment and to seek process improvements and personal development actively.
WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT
Be detail-oriented. High level of thoroughness, accuracy, organization, and productivity;
Communicate fluently in English (advanced written skills);
Availability to work 40 hours per week during American business hoursç
Eager to learn and keen on coaching and feedback;
Open to failure and rejection in the spirit of learning, progress, and resilienceç
Ability to demonstrate a level of success in executing a repeatable operation methodologyç
Must be self-motivated, persistent, and able to work independently. WHAT MAKES THIS JOB A GREAT OPPORTUNITY
Build subject-matter expertise in an area of real estate operations and insurance that is lucrative and is undergoing serious digital transformation;
Fair compensation with pay raises and bonuses;
Mentorship from talented leaders;
Be part of an award-winning company that is tracking best-in-class Saa S growth month-over-month;
Be part of a lean and agile team, with a strong culture;
Help Jones execute a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world;
Gain a strong understanding of Saa S operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company. OUR CULTURE
Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their roles and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward.
Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:
We get things done, period, full stop
We give help generously
We fall in love with customer problems
We feel the pain, then we fix the process
We build trust everywhere
We take care of ourselves with rest, time away from work and simply having fun ABOUT JONES
Jones helps real estate and construction firms to remove the barrier of insurance compliance through one software application that integrates with core operating systems. We envision a world where every property and construction site is connected by a network of insurance data enabling individuals to find, check and verify compliance instantly. Over 1 billion square feet of real estate relies on Jones daily, including firms such as Empire State Realty, Tishman Speyer, JLL, Rudin Management, and many more.
We have headquarters in New York, NY, and Tel Aviv, Israel. Our team spans 16 countries. Brazil's crew is expanding fast, fully remote, with annual in-person gatherings.

title: Visual & brand experience designer
description:
Visual & Brand Experience Designer
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Visual & Brand Experience Designer to support a large-scale digital product initiative focused on modernizing the user experience of a leading marketplace platform. This role will play a key part in reimagining how customers navigate and interact with a multi-brand digital ecosystem.
You will lead the Visual Makeover & Usability workstream while also helping shape a multi-brand gallery experience that brings together multiple brands within a single marketplace environment. The ideal candidate is a highly creative product designer who can quickly move from research and benchmarking into compelling visual concepts that inspire stakeholders and guide product direction.
This is a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles, so comfort working in ambiguous environments and presenting bold ideas to senior stakeholders is essential.
What You'll Do
Design and lead the visual direction for key product workstreams focused on improving usability and modernizing the marketplace interface.
Conduct benchmarking of leading global marketplace platforms to inform design strategy and identify best-in-class user experience patterns.
Develop high-fidelity visual concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate new interface directions and inspire product leadership.
Design and prototype a multi-brand navigation and discovery experience that enables users to seamlessly browse across brands within a unified marketplace.
Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate design ideas into clear product directions.
Present design concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders, helping guide decision-making around product experience and visual identity.
Work within a fast-moving consulting team delivering iterative design outputs across short delivery cycles. Required Qualifications
5+ years of experience in product design, visual design, or UI design
Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality interface design and visual storytelling
Deep understanding of e-commerce and marketplace design patterns
Experience analyzing and benchmarking international digital products
Ability to produce high-fidelity concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate bold design ideas
Comfort presenting conceptual work to senior leadership and stakeholders
Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
Ability to thrive in fast-paced consulting environments with rapid iteration cycles Preferred Qualifications
Experience designing multi-brand digital ecosystems or marketplaces
Familiarity with Asian marketplace and super-app UX paradigms such as those seen in Alibaba, Shopee, or Pinduoduo
Background working with retail, consumer products, or marketplace platforms
Previous experience in agency or consulting environments with fast delivery timelines If you're a designer who enjoys pushing visual boundaries, exploring global product patterns, and shaping the experience of large-scale digital platforms, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a high-visibility product initiative.

title: Lead netsuite sspecialist
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.
At Andela, we're deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E. P. I. C. way! We're excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you'll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.
Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!
Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you're considering applying, get your application in quickly!
About the client
A global organization that acquires and scales vertical market software companies delivering mission-critical solutions in specialized industries. The company focuses on long-term growth, operational excellence, and customer success, providing acquired businesses with a permanent home where they can continue to thrive. Operating with an active mergers and acquisitions strategy, the organization creates a fast-paced environment where finance and operations teams play a crucial role in integrating new businesses and driving scalable processes. About the role
The Lead Finance Systems (Oracle Net Suite) Specialist is responsible for leading end-to-end ERP integration projects for newly acquired companies. This role focuses on migrating legacy financial systems into a centralized Oracle Net Suite environment and ensuring alignment with standardized financial processes. You will oversee discovery, configuration, migration, and post-go-live support with minimal oversight. Working closely with finance leadership and operational teams, you will ensure data integrity, compliance, and successful adoption of the new systems. This is a leadership role requiring both technical ERP expertise and strong project management skills. Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end migration projects for newly acquired companies, including legacy ERP data migration and system configuration. Conduct discovery sessions to understand current-state processes and design future-state configurations within Oracle Net Suite and connected tools. Create and manage project plans, timelines, risks, and deliverables, ensuring on-time and high-quality execution. Coordinate the migration of chart of accounts, vendors, customers, transactions, and ledger balances from legacy ERPs into Net Suite. Lead configuration and deployment of core modules within Net Suite (e.g., GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Bank Recs, etc.). Standardize financial processes across acquired entities to align with group policies and reporting standards. Collaborate with accounting and finance teams to ensure business readiness for go-live and support month-end close activities post-migration. Serve as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders, including acquired company finance teams, internal technical resources, and group leadership. Present regular updates and recommendations to the group finance and senior leadership. Document system configurations, process flows, and migration procedures for knowledge transfer and audit purposes. Contribute to the refinement of deployment methodologies and onboarding playbooks to drive scalability and efficiency. Must have skills
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field. 4+ years of experience in ERP migration, financial systems implementation, or post-merger integration. Hands-on experience with Oracle Net Suite, including system configuration and data migration. Strong understanding of finance and accounting processes, including multi-entity, intercompany, consolidation, and reporting structures. Proven ability to manage complex projects independently and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience with SQL (4+ years). Net Suite experience. Architectural design experience. Integration experience. Leadership experience. Strong analytical, organizational, and detail-oriented mindset. Nice to have skills
CPA designation. Experience with tools and technologies such as One World, Suite Success, Suite Cloud, ETL processes, CSV imports, data mapping, data cleansing, and integration frameworks. Experience with the implementation and integration of financial systems. Strong collaboration skills. Conditions
Remote role (100% remote). Primary timezone: UTC-4 with at least 6 hours of overlap required with U. S. time zones. Contractor role — 12-month contract, renewable. Full-time dedication (40 hours/week). BYOD (bring your own device) required. At Andela, we know our strengths lie in our diverse community whose talents, perspectives, backgrounds and orientations we take pride in. Andela is committed to nurturing a work environment where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. Everyone has the right to work in a professional atmosphere that promotes equal employment opportunities and prohibits discriminatory practices.
Andela provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to factors including but not limited to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy (including breastfeeding), genetic information, HIV/AIDS or any other medical status, family or parental status, marital status, amnesty or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. This commitment applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including but not limited to hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Our policies expressly prohibit any form of harassment and/or discrimination, as stated above.

title: *gameshow host*
description:
Game Presenter em São Paulo
Vem brilhar diante das câmeras em uma empresa líder em tecnologia!
Salário competitivo + bônus por performance
Make & styling profissionais todos os dias
Estúdio moderno em SP
Time internacional, vibe dinâmica e crescimento real
Sem experiência? Relaxa — a gente te transforma em estrela!
Pronto(a) para brilhar? Candidate-se agora!
Sobre a empresa
Somos uma empresa líder em tecnologia que redefine padrões de qualidade no setor de i Gaming, entregando experiências incríveis para milhões de jogadores ao redor do mundo.
Com mais de 12.000 profissionais em países como Canadá, Índia, Malta, Romênia, Sérvia, Colômbia, Emirados Árabes e muito mais, estamos moldando o futuro do entretenimento digital — e você pode fazer parte disso.
O que é um Game Presenter?
É você quem comanda o jogo ao vivo: apresenta, interage, distribui cartas e cria uma experiência envolvente para jogadores online.
Não precisa ter experiência — você recebe treinamento completo no nosso novo estúdio em Santo Amaro, com ambiente moderno e super tecnológico.
O estúdio funciona 24/7, então você escolhe os turnos que combinam com sua rotina.
O que você vai fazer
Ser o centro das atenções, apresentando Blackjack com carisma e profissionalismo
Brilhar diante das câmeras com confiança (a gente te treina para isso!)
Manter ritmo, foco e boa energia trabalhando com um time global
Criar uma experiência tão boa que os jogadores vão querer voltar sempre O que esperamos de você
Português nativo
Inglês intermediário (B2)
Disponibilidade para turnos flexíveis
Vontade de ser o rosto da marca e entregar entretenimento de qualidade
Habilidades de apresentação (ou vontade de aprender rapidinho!) O que oferecemos
Salário fixo competitivo
Benefícios como transporte e outros
Treinamento completo + workshops de desenvolvimento
Learning Hub com oportunidades reais de crescimento
Estúdio incrível em um prédio icônico de São Paulo
Aparições diante das câmeras e evolução contínua das suas skills de apresentação

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
This position offers you the opportunity to join a fast-growing technology organization that is redefining productivity paradigms in the software engineering industry. Thanks to our flexible, distributed model of global operation and the high caliber of our experts, we have enjoyed triple digit growth over the past five years, creating amazing career opportunities for our people.
If you want to accelerate your career working with like-minded subject matter experts, solving interesting problems and building the products of tomorrow, this opportunity is for you.
We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with strong Go (Golang) expertise and hands-on experience building secure, high-throughput systems in crypto, blockchain, or financial domains.
This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, cryptography, and regulated financial infrastructure, contributing to mission-critical platforms that process high-value transactions at scale.
The impact you'll make:
Design, implement, and maintain high-availability backend services using Go (Golang).
Build and evolve crypto-native systems, including wallets, custody services, transaction pipelines, and blockchain integrations.
Develop secure APIs and internal services that handle sensitive financial and cryptographic operations.
Collaborate with product and architecture teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Optimize systems for performance, reliability, and fault tolerance in distributed environments.
Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and production incident resolution.
Ensure compliance with security, auditability, and regulatory requirements typical of financial and crypto platforms.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native deployment strategies.
Act as a technical advisor within the engagement, supporting best practices and engineering excellence Technology Stack:
Go (Golang)
Blockchain What you'll bring to us:
5+ years of backend engineering experience, with a strong focus on Go.
Prior exposure to crypto, fintech, payments, or financial infrastructure is highly preferred.
Experience working in consulting, staff augmentation, or cross-team delivery models is a plus.
Ability to operate autonomously while collaborating effectively with distributed teams.
Strong communication skills in English, able to explain complex technical topics to mixed audiences.
Pragmatic problem-solver with a delivery-oriented mindset.
Comfortable working in fast-moving environments with evolving requirements.
Ability to balance client needs, technical quality, and delivery timelines.
Desirable experience with Hashing (SHA-256, Keccak), Digital signatures (ECDSA, Ed DSA), Go crypto libraries, Blockchain.
Required to be located in Sao Paulo or Rio de Janeiro. Some of the benefits you'll enjoy working with us:
The chance to work in innovative projects with leading brands, that use the latest technologies that fuel transformation.
The opportunity to be part of an amazing, multicultural community of tech experts.
A flexible and remote working environment.

Programação orientada a objetos;
Experiência com Java (21 ou 24)
Experiência com Kotlin;
Frameworks como Spring Boot, Spring Data, e uso de JPA;
Design de APIs REST;
Arquitetura de microsserviços;
Conhecimento em princípios como SOLID, Clean Code e padrões de projeto;
Experiência com CI/CD e ferramentas de automação;
Testes unitários e de integração;
Conhecimento em Docker e conteinerização;
Familiaridade com mensageria (ex.: Kafka, Rabbit MQ, SQS, SNS);

title: People business partner
description:
This role is part of the People Success area and acts as a strategic partner to leaders and teams, ensuring a high-impact, culture-aligned employee experience throughout the full journey. The role owns end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, provides ongoing support and coaching to organizational leaders, and leads initiatives related to culture, benefits, and corporate social responsibility (CSR), always with a continuous improvement and scalability mindset.
What You'll Do:
Own and lead end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring a smooth, consistent, and culture-aligned employee experience.
Act as a strategic partner to leaders, providing ongoing guidance, coaching, and support on team health, performance, engagement, and complex people situations.
Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees and managers, delivering high-quality internal client support with a strong service mindset.
Drive and execute culture and engagement initiatives that strengthen Qubika's values and employee experience across teams.
Identify improvement opportunities through feedback and data, and implement scalable solutions to enhance People processes and the overall employee lifecycle. What we expect from you:
Experience working for Brazilian companies in Brazil. SP/Curtiva Preferred
4+ years of experience in HRBP/People Partner/HR Generalist roles with strong leadership exposure within tech companies.
Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field; advanced degree is a plus.
Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal). Fluent Spanish nice to have.
Experience working in dynamic, multicultural and/or distributed environments is a plus.
Previous experience with Workday is a plus. Soft Skills
Clear, empathetic, and assertive communication.
Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
Strategic mindset with strong execution.
Autonomy, prioritization, and multi-stakeholder management.
Analytical thinking and Data-driven approach to People practices. What we offer:
Exciting and innovative projects for disruptive start-ups and world-class companies.
A creative working environment with a positive and collaborative atmosphere within an open-minded community.
A senior team that offers mentorship opportunities to help you excel in your career.
Enjoy a range of benefits at Qubika, including flexible work hours, ongoing skill development, language lessons, travel opportunities, engaging activities, expert talks, and more.
